provinces.blurb_en: The mountain city: stairs, staircase alleys and residential-block kitchens where the spice comes in buckets.
provinces.blurb_zh: 山城，层层叠叠的坡坎和居民楼里的苍蝇馆子，辣是按勺放的。

provinces.blurb_en: Peppercorn country. Chengdu for skewers and hot pot, and smaller cities like Zigong and Luzhou for food that even locals call dangerous.
provinces.blurb_zh: 花椒之乡。成都的串串、火锅，自贡、泸州这些小城的“本地人都怕”的辣。

provinces.blurb_en: Sour and spicy: fermented sour soup, chili by the ladle, and rice noodles for breakfast, lunch and late-night snacks.
provinces.blurb_zh: 酸辣之地：酸汤、成勺的辣椒，从早到晚都在嗦粉。

provinces.blurb_en: Wild mushrooms, rice noodles, border markets and barbecue. Fresher and less oily than its neighbours, with Southeast Asian accents near the border.
provinces.blurb_zh: 野生菌、米线、边境集市和烧烤；比邻省清爽，边境一带带着东南亚味道。

provinces.blurb_en: High-altitude eating at 4,000 m in eastern Tibet: yak, butter tea and appetites shrunk by thin air.
provinces.blurb_zh: 藏东海拔四千米的干饭：牦牛、酥油茶，以及被缺氧压住的胃口。

impressions.quote_zh: 一般游客来到大理，都是在苍山下、洱海边打个卡
impressions.quote_en: Most tourists in Dali just snap photos under Cangshan and by Erhai Lake.

impressions.quote_zh: 全国高校人才最密集的农村
impressions.quote_en: The village with China's densest concentration of university researchers.

tips.en: Gusheng village sits right on Erhai Lake, a short trip from the tourist strip, and is a quieter way to see rural Dali.
tips.zh: 古生村就在洱海边，离热门景点不远，是看大理乡村更安静的去处。

cities.verdict_en: Not a food episode: the hosts skip the Erhai lakeside photo spots and visit Gusheng village, where 300 graduate students live year-round helping farmers and protecting the lake.
cities.verdict_zh: 这期不讲吃：主播没去洱海边打卡，而是去了古生村，那里常住着300多名研究生，帮农户种地、保护洱海。

impressions.quote_zh: 云南真给我一种很自在的感觉
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan makes me feel completely at ease.

impressions.quote_zh: 吃一道菜换一个蘸碟，烧烤真的是非常厉害
impressions.quote_en: A new dip for every dish. This barbecue is seriously impressive.

impressions.quote_zh: 最令外地人闻风丧胆，却又忍不住一探究竟
impressions.quote_en: The dish outsiders fear most, and can't resist trying.

impressions.quote_zh: 在美丽的云南芒市，偶遇拥有美丽心灵的语文老师
impressions.quote_en: In beautiful Mangshi we met a teacher with a beautiful heart.

impressions.quote_zh: 一个极具东南亚风情的中国边境小城
impressions.quote_en: A Chinese border town full of Southeast Asian flavor.

impressions.quote_zh: 插根筷子都能长出竹子的地方
impressions.quote_en: A place where a chopstick stuck in the ground grows into bamboo.

impressions.quote_zh: 装修很闪的大店，味道不一定好
impressions.quote_en: The flashy big restaurants aren't necessarily the tasty ones.

impressions.quote_zh: 地理位置非常特殊，所以有很多东南亚的东西
impressions.quote_en: Its location is special, so there's a lot of Southeast Asian food here.

impressions.quote_zh: 每个认真生活着的普通人，都值得被一键三连
impressions.quote_en: Every ordinary person living earnestly deserves a like.

tips.en: During the Water-Splashing Festival (mid-April) even pharmacies close in the afternoon. Buy a water gun with a straight nozzle, not a shower head, and expect to be soaked.
tips.zh: 泼水节（4月中旬）期间药店下午都关门去泼水；水枪要直的喷头，不要花洒。

tips.en: At a Yunnan barbecue, ask which dip goes with which item: each ingredient has its own.
tips.zh: 吃云南烧烤要问清哪样配哪种蘸碟，每样食材各不相同。

tips.en: Work up to sapie: lime version first, then the bitter one. Wrap noodles and meat in the chive leaves before dipping.
tips.zh: 撒撇要循序渐进：先柠檬撒，再苦撒；用韭菜把米线和肉卷起来再蘸。

tips.en: Handle 'swish' chili only with chopsticks and swish it just a few times.
tips.zh: 涮涮辣只能用筷子夹，涮几下就够。

tips.en: Dehong breakfast shops have free condiment bars. Add fresh lime and mint to a clear-broth noodle soup, as locals do.
tips.zh: 德宏早点铺调料免费随便加，学当地人挤新鲜柠檬、放薄荷。

tips.en: In Dehong, follow locals into the back alleys: the best crab and Burmese food is in small shops, often with Burmese cooks.
tips.zh: 在德宏跟着本地人钻小巷子：好吃的螃蟹和缅甸菜多在小店，很多是缅甸厨师。

cities.verdict_en: The Dehong border town that feels like Southeast Asia: Burmese crabs, sour sapie dips, breakfast bars with twenty free condiments and a barbecue where every ingredient gets its own dip. The hosts loved the people as much as the food.
cities.verdict_zh: 有东南亚味的德宏边城：缅甸青蟹、酸辣撒撇、二十多种免费调料的早点、每样食材配一种蘸碟的烧烤。主播对这里的人和食物一样喜欢。

impressions.quote_zh: 六盘水是一个非常凉快的地方
impressions.quote_en: Liupanshui is wonderfully cool.

impressions.quote_zh: 本地人对外地人都蛮友好的
impressions.quote_en: Locals are really friendly to outsiders.

tips.en: Liupanshui is 16–18°C on summer evenings: bring a jacket even in July.
tips.zh: 六盘水夏天晚上只有16–18度，七月也要带外套。

tips.en: Heavy rain can close roads to scenic spots; plan flexible days if you rent a car.
tips.zh: 大雨会封路，景区可能去不了；自驾要留机动时间。

cities.verdict_en: Guizhou's 'cool capital', 16–18°C on summer nights. The hosts came to escape the heat and stayed for mountain-goat mutton noodles, a funky ¥25 fermented-bean hot pot and a whole mountain of laoguo griddle restaurants beside an old coal mine.
cities.verdict_zh: 贵州“凉都”，夏夜只有16–18度。主播来避暑，结果吃上了黑山羊羊肉粉、25元豆豉火锅和老煤矿旁满山的烙锅。

impressions.quote_zh: 位置偏远，来西双版纳旅游的人很少会来到这里
impressions.quote_en: It's remote; few Xishuangbanna tourists ever make it here.

impressions.quote_zh: 云南真的是植物王国
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan really is a kingdom of plants.

impressions.quote_zh: 所以贵的蜂蜜是有原因的
impressions.quote_en: So that's why good honey is expensive.

impressions.quote_zh: 很辛苦很辛苦，但是现在吃一顿饭很幸福
impressions.quote_en: Exhausting, really exhausting. But this meal now is pure happiness.

impressions.quote_zh: 在这里吃跟在景区吃的感觉不太一样
impressions.quote_en: Eating here feels nothing like eating at a tourist site.

impressions.quote_zh: 赶摆就是游客绝对不会来的地方
impressions.quote_en: A village ganbai market is somewhere tourists never come.

impressions.quote_zh: 吃到老挝火锅，喝着老挝啤酒，就像到了老挝
impressions.quote_en: Laotian hot pot and Lao beer: it's like being in Laos.

tips.en: Mengla's Wangtianshu rainforest has a canopy walkway strung between China's tallest trees (up to 88 m). Not for anyone afraid of heights.
tips.zh: 勐腊望天树景区有连在中国最高的树（最高88米）之间的树冠走廊，恐高慎入。

tips.en: Mid-April is the Dai New Year (Water-Splashing Festival). Villages hold feasts and soak everyone, so keep phones in waterproof bags.
tips.zh: 4月中旬是傣历新年泼水节，寨子里会摆宴席、全村泼水，手机要装防水袋。

tips.en: Village weekend markets (赶摆 gǎnbǎi) in Xishuangbanna start around 8 a.m. on Saturdays. Arrive early: everything is cooked fresh and sells out.
tips.zh: 西双版纳村寨的赶摆一般周六早上8点开始，东西现做现卖，要早去。

tips.en: Many Dai-run shops close for Dai New Year (mid-April). Check ahead or eat at Han- or Lao-run places.
tips.zh: 傣历新年（4月中旬）很多傣族店铺关门，提前确认或去汉族、老挝人开的店。

tips.en: Squeeze Yunnan green limes into your dip: they're far more fragrant than yellow lemons.
tips.zh: 蘸水里挤云南青柠檬，香味比黄柠檬浓好几倍。

cities.verdict_en: A remote corner of Xishuangbanna on the Laos border, and one of the hosts' favorite finds: Dai village markets at 8 a.m., pineapple rice, mint treated as a vegetable, Laotian hot pot and real Water-Splashing Festival celebrations. Few tourists make it this far.
cities.verdict_zh: 西双版纳挨着老挝的偏远小城，是主播最爱的发现之一：早上8点的傣寨赶摆、菠萝饭、当青菜吃的薄荷、老挝火锅和原汁原味的泼水节，游客很少。

impressions.quote_zh: 云南这边有太多我们不知道的东西了
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan has so much food we've never heard of.

impressions.quote_zh: 她就像云南的云一样温柔地包裹着你
impressions.quote_en: She's like Yunnan's clouds, wrapping you up gently.

impressions.quote_zh: 我整个晚上都非常开心非常舒服
impressions.quote_en: I was happy and relaxed the whole evening.

impressions.quote_zh: 云南人都喜欢好看
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan people like things to look nice.

impressions.quote_zh: 云南这边其实整体的口味偏重一点
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan food overall leans salty and strong.

tips.en: Dai hand-grab rice is meant to be eaten with gloved hands: a pinch of rice plus a bit of each dish, pressed loosely into a ball. Chopsticks are fine too.
tips.zh: 傣味手抓饭是戴手套用手吃：抓点米饭和菜，松松地团成团；用筷子也可以。

tips.en: The dried pickled greens in the sour soup are very tough. Even staff say most people don't eat them.
tips.zh: 汤里的干腌菜很难嚼，服务员说一般没人吃。

tips.en: Yunnan barbecue always includes potatoes, and locals brush the grill with chives first for extra aroma.
tips.zh: 云南烧烤必有土豆；本地人先用韭菜刷烤网，烤出来更香。

tips.en: Yunnan markets sell fruit by the basket or kilo, far cheaper than at home: blueberries were ¥45/kg.
tips.zh: 云南集市水果按筐或公斤卖，蓝莓45元一公斤。

cities.verdict_en: Smaller stops around Yunnan from 2022: a Dai hand-grab platter, a roadside barbecue with three kinds of dip, and a country market with pine-smoked beef. Recurring theme: lots of coriander, lots of fruit, and food that leans salty and sour.
cities.verdict_zh: 2022年在云南各地的小站：傣味手抓饭、三种蘸碟的路边烧烤、松毛烤牛肉的乡间集市。共同点：香菜多、水果多、口味偏咸偏酸。

impressions.quote_zh: 这只是安顺人超高吃商的冰山一角
impressions.quote_en: And that's just the tip of Anshun's 'eating IQ'.

impressions.quote_zh: 你们来旅游，吃得胖胖的回去
impressions.quote_en: You're tourists. Go home nice and plump.

impressions.quote_zh: 生活就在这冷暖交替的缝隙里被过出了滋味
impressions.quote_en: Between the cold rain and the warm pots, life here is full of flavor.

tips.en: Guizhou weather turns cold fast when it rains. Locals answer with hot pots, so pack a warm layer even in mild seasons.
tips.zh: 贵州一下雨就像过冬，当地人靠锅子取暖；带件厚外套。

tips.en: Shops that put the owner's own face on the signboard are usually good: it's a point of pride in Anshun.
tips.zh: 安顺用老板自己头像做招牌的店，一般都不错。

tips.en: Try cili (Rosa roxburghii), 'Guizhou's vitamin-C king', at the morning market.
tips.zh: 早市可以试试“贵州维C之王”刺梨。

cities.verdict_en: The hosts crowned this small Guizhou city China's highest 'eating IQ'. Nineteen meals in three days: a ¥36.8 grilled-intestine buffet, potato cakes packed with fish-mint, puffed pig trotters in sour soup and a teenage barbecue 'boy band'.
cities.verdict_zh: 主播封安顺为中国“吃商”最高的城市：三天19顿，36块8的自助烤小肠、加满折耳根的洋芋粑、灌汤猪脚酸汤锅、19岁男团烧烤。

impressions.quote_zh: 吃一碗蒙自的米线，脸变红了
impressions.quote_en: One bowl of Mengzi noodles and my face turned red.

impressions.quote_zh: 这么大的碗，对本地人来说稀松平常
impressions.quote_en: A bowl this huge is just normal for locals.

tips.en: Some meat goes into the bowl raw and cooks in the broth. Push it under the hot soup before eating.
tips.zh: 很多肉料下碗时是生的，要浸在热汤里烫熟再吃。

tips.en: Locals say the fresh chili oil 'isn't spicy'. It is, a little, but it's mostly fragrant. Add a generous spoon.
tips.zh: 本地人说油辣子“不辣”，其实有点辣，但主要是香，可以多放。

cities.verdict_en: The birthplace of crossing-the-bridge noodles, near the Vietnam border. Bowls are enormous, you pick your price by how much meat you want, and locals swear the fresh chili oil 'isn't spicy'.
cities.verdict_zh: 过桥米线的发源地，靠近越南边境。碗巨大，按肉料选价位，本地人说新炸的油辣子“不辣”。

impressions.quote_zh: 希望我们都能积极调整好自己的心态
impressions.quote_en: Here's to all of us bouncing back from a bad day.

impressions.quote_zh: 我们当地的人都非常的好客
impressions.quote_en: People here are incredibly hospitable.

impressions.quote_zh: 现在吃到之后觉得还是可以接受的
impressions.quote_en: Now that I've tried it, it's actually fine.

impressions.quote_zh: 凯里这边真的是我见过晚上最热闹的
impressions.quote_en: Kaili at night is the liveliest place I've seen.

tips.en: Guizhou yellow-cattle beef is lean and chewy, closer to jerky than to marbled hot-pot beef. Cook it briefly.
tips.zh: 贵州黄牛肉精瘦有嚼劲，像牛肉干，涮一下就好。

tips.en: Niubie sounds extreme but is mildly bitter and grassy. Order it with a beef hot pot and dip everything in chili for an easy first try.
tips.zh: 牛瘪听着吓人，其实只是微苦带青草香；配牛肉火锅、蘸辣椒最好入门。

tips.en: Kaili's night-market snacks are mostly ¥1 a piece: graze stall to stall rather than sitting down for one meal.
tips.zh: 凯里夜市小吃大多一块一串，适合一路逛一路吃。

cities.verdict_en: Capital of Qiandongnan's Miao and Dong country and the home of sour soup. Night markets sell everything for ¥1, tofu is grilled at tiny one-woman stalls, and the brave can try niubie hot pot, which turned out far gentler than its reputation.
cities.verdict_zh: 黔东南苗侗之乡、酸汤的故乡：夜市一块一串，阿姨一人一炉烤小豆腐；胆大可以试牛瘪火锅，结果比传说中温和得多。

impressions.quote_zh: 云南人太爱吃有毒的啦
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan people just love eating the poisonous ones.

impressions.quote_zh: 云南人酒必须倒满
impressions.quote_en: In Yunnan, you always fill the glass to the brim.

impressions.quote_zh: 每次到了云南，总感觉物产丰富得眼睛都不够用
impressions.quote_en: Every time I'm in Yunnan, there's so much produce my eyes can't keep up.

impressions.quote_zh: 在云南买咖啡就像逛菜市场一样方便
impressions.quote_en: Buying coffee in Yunnan is as easy as going to the market.

impressions.quote_zh: 吃到这个砂锅米线，就是开始放假的信号
impressions.quote_en: This clay-pot noodle meant the school holidays had begun.

tips.en: Never eat wild mushrooms raw or cold-dressed, and never eat leftovers: reheated mushrooms are the main cause of poisoning. Restaurants refuse takeaway for this reason.
tips.zh: 见手青千万不能生吃、凉拌；隔夜菌最容易中毒，所以店家严禁打包。

tips.en: Yunnan hospitals run a seasonal mushroom-poisoning ward every summer. Order from a specialist restaurant and let them cook it.
tips.zh: 云南医院每年菌子季都有专门的菌中毒科，去专业菌子馆吃最稳妥。

tips.en: At the wild-mushroom market, only buy from sellers who let you pick each mushroom yourself. Vendors who insist on handing you a pre-packed bunch may hide low-grade mushrooms underneath. Pale, waterlogged ones are poor quality.
tips.zh: 买野生菌要找让你自己挑的摊；只肯捧着卖的可能好货盖面、次货压底；颜色泛白、水分重的不要。

tips.en: Kunming markets price by the kilogram, not the jin (500 g) used elsewhere in China, so '30' means ¥30/kg.
tips.zh: 昆明菜市场多用公斤计价，说30就是30元一公斤。

tips.en: Donghua farmers' market has free volunteer guides (retirees) who explain local produce. Ask at the market.
tips.zh: 东华农贸市场有退休志愿者免费讲解本地物产。

tips.en: Mushroom hot pots run on a timer: don't eat before the staff say the mushrooms are cooked (around 20 minutes).
tips.zh: 菌子火锅要计时，服务员说可以吃之前别动筷（约20分钟）。

cities.verdict_en: Yunnan's capital is the gateway to wild-mushroom country. In season the hosts were floored by how fresh and savory the mushrooms are, by markets selling everything from flowers to fried scorpions, and by a coffee culture that lives right inside the wet markets.
cities.verdict_zh: 云南的大门，也是野生菌的天下。菌子季的鲜让主播惊呆了；菜市场从鲜花卖到油炸蝎子，咖啡就开在菜市场里。

impressions.quote_zh: 到了贵阳之后，发现我们对火锅的了解太少了
impressions.quote_en: Guiyang showed us how little we knew about hot pot.

impressions.quote_zh: 老街比较讲感情的
impressions.quote_en: On the old street, people look out for each other.

impressions.quote_zh: 贵阳这边有一百种吃豆腐的方式
impressions.quote_en: Guiyang has a hundred ways to eat tofu.

impressions.quote_zh: 恋爱的味道就是很幸福啊
impressions.quote_en: The taste of love is pure happiness.

impressions.quote_zh: 这里菜市场的菜摆得特别的整齐
impressions.quote_en: The market produce here is arranged beautifully.

tips.en: The douchi smell clings to clothes. Don't wear anything you need to keep fresh.
tips.zh: 豆豉味会留在衣服上，别穿要保持清爽的衣服。

tips.en: New to zhe'ergen? Eat it with fatty pork: the fat softens its fishy, herbal punch.
tips.zh: 第一次吃折耳根，配五花肉一起嚼，油脂能冲淡那股鱼腥草味。

tips.en: At Guiyang barbecue you pay by the number of empty skewers at the end, so don't return a skewer once it's on your table.
tips.zh: 贵阳烧烤最后数签子结账，串上桌就不能退。

tips.en: Changwang noodles are served warm, not scalding, and hold their texture, so take your time with them.
tips.zh: 肠旺面端上来不会太烫，面也不容易坨，可以慢慢吃。

cities.verdict_en: Guizhou's capital runs on carbs and fish-mint: ¥10 sticky-rice breakfasts, changwang noodles, ¥10 fermented-bean hot pot made for rice, and barbecue where locals heap zhe'ergen into their dip. Food is cheap and the old streets are friendly.
cities.verdict_zh: 贵州省会，靠碳水和折耳根运转：10元糯米饭早餐、肠旺面、为米饭而生的10元豆豉火锅、往蘸水里狂加折耳根的烧烤。便宜，老街人情味浓。

impressions.quote_zh: 有人说它是最没存在感的云南小城
impressions.quote_en: Some say it's Yunnan's most overlooked city.

impressions.quote_zh: 走在路上，当地的人总爱跟你聊上两句
impressions.quote_en: Walking around, locals always stop to chat.

impressions.quote_zh: 保山的咖啡最苦，嘴却很甜
impressions.quote_en: Baoshan's coffee is bitter, but its people are sweet.

tips.en: Yunnan wet markets are the best breakfast spots: stalls inside sell local specialties for a few yuan.
tips.zh: 云南菜市场是吃早饭最好的地方，里面的小摊几块钱就能吃到特色。

tips.en: Wear sunscreen: the high-altitude Yunnan sun burns fast.
tips.zh: 一定要防晒，云南太阳很容易晒伤。

tips.en: Finish a Yunnan hot pot with erkuai rice cakes instead of noodles.
tips.zh: 云南火锅最后不下面条，要下饵块。

cities.verdict_en: Called Yunnan's most overlooked city, and the hosts wondered why. A single day here gave them pea-porridge noodles for ¥5, chili-dusted sour fruit, drumsticks worth queuing for, farm coffee by the Nujiang and copper-pot beef.
cities.verdict_zh: 号称云南最没存在感的城市，主播却吃得停不下来：5元稀豆粉米线、辣椒拌酸水果、值得排队的鸡腿、怒江边的咖啡、铜锅牛肉。

impressions.quote_zh: 深山里头居然能藏着这么多烧烤师傅
impressions.quote_en: Who knew so many barbecue masters were hiding in these mountains?

impressions.quote_zh: 同样的肉同样的炭，不同的人烤出来就是不同的味
impressions.quote_en: Same meat, same charcoal: different hands, different flavor.

tips.en: Locals grill slowly and turn often. If your meat burns, ask your neighbours: the Yi aunties at the next basin will happily take over.
tips.zh: 本地人烤得慢、翻得勤；烤不好可以请旁边的彝族姐姐帮忙。

tips.en: The bitter greens they toss on the grill are an acquired taste; wrap meat in lettuce instead.
tips.zh: 当地人丢上来的苦菜很苦，生菜包肉更好入口。

cities.verdict_en: A misty mountain market in Honghe where hundreds of people barbecue at 8 a.m. Buy meat from the butcher, pay ¥10 to have it marinated, then grill it yourself next to Yi grandmothers who will happily take over.
cities.verdict_zh: 红河云雾山里的集市，早上8点几百人一起烧烤：肉铺买肉、交10元腌制、自己烤，旁边的彝族姐姐会来帮忙。

impressions.quote_zh: 一半江山在吃辣，一半江山在吃酸
impressions.quote_en: In Guizhou, half the province eats spicy, the other half eats sour.

impressions.quote_zh: 随便一个小路口一拐就别有一番天地
impressions.quote_en: Turn down any little lane and a whole new world opens up.

impressions.quote_zh: 在遵义，鸡只有一种活法，但是有一百种死法
impressions.quote_en: In Zunyi, a chicken has one way to live and a hundred ways to be cooked.

impressions.quote_zh: 厂子没了，但当年那些食物都留下来了
impressions.quote_en: The factories are gone, but the food they inspired remains.

impressions.quote_zh: 遵义的机场播报是：不要带辣椒酱
impressions.quote_en: Zunyi airport announcements warn you not to pack chili sauce.

impressions.quote_zh: 遵义这边的烧烤会偏咸一点，但味道是OK的
impressions.quote_en: Zunyi barbecue runs a little salty, but the flavor's good.

tips.en: Order sour soup at 'medium' unless you grew up on it: past your sourness tolerance it stops being a treat.
tips.zh: 酸汤一般点中酸；超过自己的耐受就不是美食了。

tips.en: Test the temperature with your lips before eating: hot-pot food straight from the pot can scald.
tips.zh: 吃之前先用嘴唇碰一下，太烫就吹吹再吃。

tips.en: At mutton-noodle shops, customise with the table condiments (Sichuan pepper, salt, vinegar, soy, raw garlic) and add a bite of meat to every mouthful.
tips.zh: 吃羊肉粉可按口味加桌上的麻椒、盐、醋、酱油、蒜；每一筷子都要配点肉。

tips.en: Zunyi's hillside wet markets sell house-made chili sauces: good edible souvenirs.
tips.zh: 遵义坡上的菜市场能买到各种本地辣椒酱，适合当伴手礼。

tips.en: If you can't take heat, tell the grill master before they start. Their 'normal' is very spicy.
tips.zh: 不能吃辣要提前跟老板说，本地的“一般”已经很辣。

tips.en: Chili oil and chili sauce aren't allowed in carry-on at Zunyi airport; pack them in checked luggage.
tips.zh: 遵义机场不让随身带辣椒酱、油泼辣椒，要托运。

cities.verdict_en: Chili capital. Zunyi buries its fish under three layers of chili, starts spicy chicken at 'medium', fills mutton noodles with burnt chili and sells house-made chili sauce on every corner. Locals always insist it 'isn't spicy'.
cities.verdict_zh: 辣椒之都：烤鱼盖三层辣椒，辣子鸡中辣起步，羊肉粉配糊辣椒，满街自制辣椒酱。本地人永远说“不辣”。

impressions.quote_zh: 云南的菌子全都是鲜
impressions.quote_en: Yunnan mushrooms are pure umami.

impressions.quote_zh: 跟你去菜地里拔菜吃一样
impressions.quote_en: For locals, foraging is as casual as picking vegetables from the garden.

tips.en: Never forage alone. Color tells you nothing about toxicity, and amanitas cause about 90% of mushroom-poisoning deaths. Go with an experienced local.
tips.zh: 千万不要自己采菌子；颜色和毒性没关系，鹅膏造成约九成菌子中毒死亡，一定要有经验的本地人带。

tips.en: Touching a poisonous mushroom is harmless; toxins only work if eaten.
tips.zh: 摸到毒菌没事，毒素要经过消化道才起作用。

cities.verdict_en: Mushroom-foraging country. With a local expert the hosts learned that color tells you nothing about toxicity, found a matsutake after an hour's search, and cooked the best mushroom meal of their trip at a hilltop campsite.
cities.verdict_zh: 采菌子的地方。跟着本地专家才知道颜色和毒性无关；找了一个小时挖到松茸，在山顶露营地做了全程最好吃的菌子宴。

impressions.quote_zh: 总把辣椒做好吃，不会说做得多辣
impressions.quote_en: They focus on making chili delicious, not just hot.

impressions.quote_zh: 因为足球而发生的变化
impressions.quote_en: Changes that came because of football.

impressions.quote_zh: 有一些话就是只有在告别的时候才会说
impressions.quote_en: Some things only get said when you say goodbye.

tips.en: Many Guizhou chili dishes come only in 'medium' or 'hot'. If you can't take heat, say so before ordering.
tips.zh: 很多贵州辣菜只有中辣和辣，没有微辣；吃不了辣要提前说。

cities.verdict_en: Two episodes without a named town: a day eating chili in every form (fire-roasted, fermented, fried) and a graduation party for a village girls' football team.
cities.verdict_zh: 两期没点明城市：一天吃遍辣椒的各种做法（火烧、糟辣、油泼），以及给山村女足办的毕业派对。

impressions.quote_zh: 在云南就可以蓝莓自由了
impressions.quote_en: In Yunnan you can eat all the blueberries you want.

impressions.quote_zh: 清澈、温柔又坚定
impressions.quote_en: Clear-eyed, gentle and determined.

cities.verdict_en: A day as fourth-graders at a Zhuang village school on the Yunnan border: student-led classes, exhausting recesses, a ¥7 lunch and fruit straight off a classmate's family trees. More about people than restaurants.
cities.verdict_zh: 在云南边境壮族村寨小学当一天四年级学生：学生讲课、累人的课间、7元午饭、同学家树上摘的水果。讲人多于讲吃。

dishes.en: Beef rolled in a sizzling mint-oil dish
dishes.what_en: A metal dish of oil, garlic, chili and mint is set right on the charcoal until it sizzles; lean beef is rolled through it. A second round in the same dish tastes even meatier.
dishes.what_zh: 油、蒜泥、辣椒、薄荷装在碟里直接放炭火上烤到滚烫，再把瘦牛肉放进去滚；第二盘肉更香。
dishes.verdict_en: Garlic, chili and fresh mint in hot oil: it tastes exactly how it looks and smells.
dishes.verdict_zh: 蒜香、辣椒香、薄荷清香在热油里滚出来，看到的、闻到的和吃到的一样。
dishes.quote_zh: 料味足，然后肉味也足
dishes.quote_en: Packed with seasoning, and packed with meat flavor too.

dishes.en: Pork belly with fermented radish-leaf paste
dishes.what_en: Grilled pork belly dipped in a thick, salty-sour paste fermented from dried radish leaves and rice water.
dishes.what_zh: 烤五花肉蘸用晒干萝卜叶和米汤发酵的黏稠腌菜膏。
dishes.verdict_en: The sour paste cuts the fat perfectly. Very appetizing.
dishes.verdict_zh: 咸咸带点发酵的酸，刚好解五花肉的腻，好开胃。
dishes.quote_zh: 哇，这好开胃啊
dishes.quote_en: Wow, this really whets the appetite.

dishes.what_en: Small tofu cubes grilled until they puff, then poked open and dropped into chili-oil dip so they suck up the sauce; inside they're runny like custard.
dishes.what_zh: 小豆腐烤到鼓起，戳个小口泡进红油蘸碟，吸满汤汁，里面是流心的豆腐浆。
dishes.verdict_en: You slurp it down in one go; the inside tastes gently fermented.
dishes.verdict_zh: 一口就能吸进嘴里，里面有发酵卤水的味道。
dishes.quote_zh: 我太喜欢豆腐的口感了
dishes.quote_en: I love this tofu texture.

dishes.what_en: Rice noodles under thick chunks of mountain-goat meat, tripe and intestine from a broth simmered four hours, topped with mutton-fat chili oil and a little Sichuan pepper; free mint on the side.
dishes.what_zh: 四小时熬的羊汤，大块带皮羊肉、羊肚、羊肠盖粉，浇羊油辣子和一点花椒，薄荷免费自取。
dishes.place_en: A lane of more than ten mutton-noodle shops in Shuicheng
dishes.place_zh: 水城一条小巷里十几家羊肉粉
dishes.verdict_en: Fragrant, not harsh. The local black goats roam the hills, so the meat is firm and the broth deeply savory. Wrap noodles in mint.
dishes.verdict_zh: 香而不辣不燥；本地黑山羊满山跑，肉紧实汤鲜；薄荷卷粉解腻。
dishes.quote_zh: 香而不辣不燥的那种感觉
dishes.quote_en: Fragrant but not fiery or harsh.

dishes.what_en: Fermented soybeans stir-fried with chili oil into a sticky base, then fresh pork, tofu skin, potato, tofu and wild greens cook in it; unlimited greens and rice.
dishes.what_zh: 发酵豆豉和红油现炒成黏稠锅底，下现切猪肉、豆皮、土豆、豆腐和野菜，菜和米饭无限。
dishes.place_en: An upstairs shop on an old Liupanshui street
dishes.place_zh: 六盘水老街阁楼上的小店
dishes.verdict_en: Smells like a fermentation vat (your clothes will too) but tastes rich, numbing and spicy. It's made for eating with rice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 闻着臭（衣服也会臭三天），吃着香，麻辣鲜香，特别下饭。
dishes.quote_zh: 不知道为什么闻着这么臭，吃嘴里这么香
dishes.quote_en: No idea why something that smells this bad tastes this good.

dishes.what_en: A shallow oiled griddle over a coal stove on your table: potatoes, stinky tofu, sausage and pork belly sizzle in it, then get dunked in dry chili powder or wrapped in lettuce.
dishes.what_zh: 桌上煤炉架一口浅油锅，烙洋芋、臭豆腐、香肠、五花肉，蘸干辣椒面或用生菜包着吃。
dishes.place_en: Jiaohua Mountain, a hill of laoguo restaurants beside a 1960s coal mine
dishes.place_zh: 焦化山，老煤矿旁整座山都是烙锅
dishes.verdict_en: Cheap and cheerful. Lettuce-wrapped pork belly loaded with chili powder was the favorite; a sour pickle soup cuts the oil.
dishes.verdict_zh: 便宜又好吃；生菜包五花肉蘸满辣椒面最好吃，配酸菜汤解腻。
dishes.quote_zh: 料一定要多蘸
dishes.quote_en: Always load up on the dip.

dishes.en: Rice noodles with a basin of pork bones
dishes.what_en: Wide, soft rice noodles (migan) that you season yourself from a long table of condiments, shared with a big basin of braised pork bones.
dishes.what_zh: 宽米干，几十种调料自己配，再来一大盆猪棒骨。
dishes.price_note_en: for the big shared basin of bones
dishes.verdict_en: Every bowl tastes different because everyone seasons their own. Listen to locals about what to add.
dishes.verdict_zh: 每个人调的味都不一样，到这儿要听当地人的建议。
dishes.quote_zh: 到这别人的建议就要听
dishes.quote_en: Here, take the locals' advice.

dishes.what_en: A dozen-plus Dai dishes spread on banana leaves: grilled pork brain in leaf parcels, fried river moss, grilled fish, sticky rice in several colors, pineapple rice and fresh vegetables.
dishes.what_zh: 十几道傣味铺在芭蕉叶上：包烧猪脑、油炸青苔、烤鱼、几种糯米饭、菠萝饭、新鲜蔬菜。
dishes.place_en: Dai restaurant near the Wangtianshu rainforest
dishes.place_zh: 望天树景区附近的傣味餐厅
dishes.verdict_en: The vegetables taste so fresh that the meat seems ordinary. The river moss is more fragrant than seaweed; the pineapple rice was the MVP.
dishes.verdict_zh: 蔬菜做的菜特别新鲜，鱼肉鸡肉反而普通了；青苔比海苔还香，菠萝饭是MVP。
dishes.quote_zh: 用蔬菜做成的食物都特别的新鲜
dishes.quote_en: Everything made from vegetables tastes incredibly fresh.

dishes.what_en: A domed grill-pot: meat sizzles on the raised center while broth simmers in the moat. The secret is the Lao chili-herb paste plus lime, chili oil and fish-mint dip. Try Lao sour pork with mustard.
dishes.what_zh: 中间凸起烤肉、四周一圈汤涮菜的锅；灵魂是老挝师傅做的老挝酱，再加柠檬、辣椒油、折耳根蘸水；老挝酸肉配芥末。
dishes.place_en: A street of Laotian hot-pot restaurants in Mengla
dishes.place_zh: 勐腊一整片老挝火锅店
dishes.verdict_en: A complex, hard-to-place flavor. The Lao sour pork is cool and tangy like sashimi.
dishes.verdict_zh: 老挝酱是很神奇的复合味；老挝酸肉凉凉的，像吃刺身。
dishes.quote_zh: 我每次吃老挝火锅感觉很幸福
dishes.quote_en: Every time I eat Laotian hot pot I feel happy.

dishes.what_en: A shared bamboo tray of Dai dishes (cold salads, stir-fries, grilled fish, fruit, colored rice and soup). Wear the gloves provided, take a little of everything with rice and press it into a ball.
dishes.what_zh: 簸箕装的傣族菜拼盘：凉菜、炒菜、烤鱼、水果、米饭和汤；戴手套抓一点饭和菜团成团吃。
dishes.verdict_en: Colorful and generous, and almost every dish uses coriander and bird's-eye chili. If you hate coriander, skip it.
dishes.verdict_zh: 花花绿绿很丰盛，几乎每道菜都放香菜和小米辣，不吃香菜的慎点。
dishes.quote_zh: 每个菜都用了香菜
dishes.quote_en: Every single dish has coriander.

dishes.what_en: Warm mashed potato with pickled mustard greens, chili and coriander.
dishes.what_zh: 热乎的土豆泥拌酸菜、辣椒、香菜。
dishes.verdict_en: Best dish on the tray: salty, gently spicy and comforting.
dishes.verdict_zh: 咸辣口，全场最佳，强力推荐。
dishes.quote_zh: 它现在是全场最佳
dishes.quote_en: This is the best thing on the table.

dishes.what_en: Fresh pineapple dusted with chili powder; sweet first, then a delayed burn in the throat.
dishes.what_zh: 新鲜菠萝撒辣椒面，先甜后辣。
dishes.verdict_en: Refreshing and appetite-whetting; the heat sneaks up after you swallow.
dishes.verdict_zh: 很清爽很开胃，咽下去喉咙才忽然辣一下。
dishes.quote_zh: 它这个辣是后辣
dishes.quote_en: The heat hits you afterwards.

dishes.what_en: Tilapia stuffed with lemongrass, chili and herbs, then grilled.
dishes.what_zh: 鱼肚子里塞香茅草、辣椒等料烤的罗非鱼。
dishes.verdict_en: Decent, strongly smoky. The lemongrass stuffing is very direct.
dishes.verdict_zh: 还不错，烧烤味浓，香茅草味道很直接。
dishes.quote_zh: 它烧烤的味还是挺浓的
dishes.quote_en: The grilled flavor is strong.

dishes.what_en: Tunpu-style grilled small intestine on a tabletop charcoal grill, plus a buffet of fresh beef, seafood, tofu, potatoes and drinks. Open until 3–5 a.m.
dishes.what_zh: 屯堡烤小肠，桌上炭火自己烤，另有鲜牛肉、海鲜、豆腐、洋芋、饮料自助，开到凌晨三四点。
dishes.verdict_en: Chewy skin, sizzling fat inside; eat it with raw garlic and dry chili dip. Impossible value.
dishes.verdict_zh: 外皮有嚼劲，脂肪滋滋响，配蒜蘸干辣椒面，36块8太值。
dishes.quote_zh: 吃100个都根本停不下来
dishes.quote_en: I could eat a hundred and still not stop.

dishes.what_en: Pan-fried mashed potato cake, crisp shell outside, packed with zhe'ergen (fish-mint root), Guizhou's signature pungent herb.
dishes.what_zh: 煎到外壳酥脆的土豆饼，灵魂是折耳根。
dishes.verdict_en: Crisp outside, soft inside, and the zhe'ergen makes it addictively fragrant.
dishes.verdict_zh: 外酥里糯，加上折耳根嘎嘎香。
dishes.quote_zh: 外面酥里面糯，加上折耳根的味道嘎嘎香
dishes.quote_en: Crispy outside, soft inside, and the fish-mint makes it amazing.

dishes.what_en: Steamed potato stir-fried with fish-mint, sausage and crispy pork bits, wrapped in a fresh omelette.
dishes.what_zh: 蒸熟的土豆加折耳根、火腿肠、脆哨翻炒，包进刚煎好的蛋皮。
dishes.verdict_en: Soft, loaded with fillings, and hard to stop eating.
dishes.verdict_zh: 软软趴趴，料很满，吃了停不下来。
dishes.quote_zh: 这玩意吃了停不下来
dishes.quote_en: Once you start you can't stop.

dishes.what_en: Pig trotters deep-fried until the skin puffs like a sponge, then simmered in red sour soup so every pore soaks up broth.
dishes.what_zh: 猪脚下热油炸到皮蓬松如云朵，再煮进红酸汤，每个气孔都吸满汤汁。
dishes.verdict_en: A burst of sour soup the moment you bite, then pork. Strange and wonderful.
dishes.verdict_zh: 一口下去先爆出满满酸汤，再是猪脚肉香，感觉很奇特。
dishes.quote_zh: 满满一口酸汤味
dishes.quote_en: A whole mouthful of sour soup.

dishes.what_en: A small sour-spicy pot of rice tofu that schoolkids used to fight over with skewers; add whatever absorbs broth.
dishes.what_zh: 起源于小学门口、大家抢着插米豆腐吃的酸辣小锅。
dishes.verdict_en: Numbing, spicy and steaming; better the longer it cooks.
dishes.verdict_zh: 麻辣鲜香冒汗，越煮越有味。
dishes.quote_zh: 越煮越久越有味
dishes.quote_en: The longer it boils, the better.

dishes.en: Bean hot pot with wild greens
dishes.what_en: A thick bean-paste hot pot eaten with a platter of Guizhou wild greens, each labelled with its folk medicinal use. Finish by stirring the broth into rice.
dishes.what_zh: 浓稠豆米锅底配贵州野菜，每种菜都有“功效名片”；最后汤汁拌饭。
dishes.verdict_en: The greens soak up the bean broth so well they eat like meat. Save the broth for rice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 野菜裹满豆沙汤汁，吃菜吃得停不下来；最后一定要拌饭。
dishes.quote_zh: 没想到有一天我吃菜吃得停不下来
dishes.quote_en: Never thought I'd be unable to stop eating vegetables.

dishes.what_en: Skewers brushed with thick sauce, showered in Guizhou chili powder, then pulled off and soaked in a fish-mint dipping broth. Finish with ¥10 zhe'ergen fried rice.
dishes.what_zh: 串串刷浓酱、撒贵州辣椒面，捋下来泡折耳根蘸水；最后来份10元折耳根炒饭。
dishes.place_en: A barbecue run by 19-year-olds who sing while they grill
dishes.place_zh: 19岁小伙们边唱歌边烤的“男团烧烤”
dishes.verdict_en: Bold seasoning. The chili oil tingles first, then the heat slaps you. The tofu is excellent thanks to Guizhou's water.
dishes.verdict_zh: 下料猛；油辣椒先麻后辣，豆腐因为贵州水好特别好吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 安顺人藏得还是太深了
dishes.quote_en: Anshun people have been hiding too much good food.

dishes.what_en: A giant bowl of scalding chicken broth. Raw meats and toppings go in first, then you add the round rice noodles yourself. In Mengzi you choose your tier by how much meat you want.
dishes.what_zh: 滚烫鸡汤里先放肉料，再自己把煮好的米线扣进去；在蒙自按肉料多少分档。
dishes.place_en: A busy local rice-noodle hall with a price board from ¥8 to ¥50
dishes.place_zh: 本地米线馆，价目表从8元到50元
dishes.verdict_en: The broth is pure chicken and very fresh. With chili oil added it climbs from savory to spicy to rich: at least three flavors in one bowl.
dishes.verdict_zh: 纯鸡汤熬的，特别鲜；加油辣子后从鲜咸到香辣再到浓郁，一碗吃出三种层次。
dishes.quote_zh: 放了辣椒之后，这个米线灵魂出来了
dishes.quote_en: Once the chili goes in, the noodles get their soul.

dishes.what_en: Paper-thin rice wrappers you fill yourself from 24 little bowls of shredded vegetables and pickles, fold like a swaddled baby, then dip in sour-spicy broth.
dishes.what_zh: 薄饼皮放在掌心，从24个小碗里挑切丝的小菜卷起来，像包着的娃娃，蘸酸辣汤吃。
dishes.verdict_en: Simple flavors; the delight is the care: 24 little bowls and building your own.
dishes.verdict_zh: 味道很简单，惊喜在于细致：24个小碗，自己动手包。
dishes.quote_zh: 它哇塞的点在于它很细致
dishes.quote_en: What's wow about it is how meticulous it is.

dishes.zh: 烤豆腐浇折耳根辣椒水
dishes.en: Grilled tofu with fish-mint chili water
dishes.what_en: A whole slab of tofu grilled until the skin chars, split and flooded with zhe'ergen and chili dipping water.
dishes.what_zh: 整块豆腐烤到外皮焦，掰开浇折耳根辣椒水。
dishes.place_en: A tiny tofu shop where people usually squat on stools
dishes.place_zh: 平时一群人蹲在小板凳上吃的豆腐店
dishes.verdict_en: Charred skin around a tender center; the soy flavor beats even the fish-mint.
dishes.verdict_zh: 焦皮裹着嫩心，豆香浓到盖过折耳根。
dishes.quote_zh: 烤得有点焦焦的，把里面嫩的给裹住了
dishes.quote_en: Charred outside, wrapping a tender center.

dishes.en: ¥35 all-you-can-eat fresh beef sour-soup hot pot
dishes.what_en: Fresh-cut Guizhou yellow-cattle beef and offal, unlimited, in a split pot of red sour soup and numbing-spicy broth; pickled radish and rice tofu included.
dishes.what_zh: 现切贵州黄牛肉和牛杂无限续，鸳鸯锅一边红酸汤一边麻辣；送泡萝卜和米豆腐。
dishes.verdict_en: Fresh, chewy beef, never frozen. The tomato-sour broth is good enough to drink straight.
dishes.verdict_zh: 新鲜现切、不是冻肉，很有嚼劲；番茄酸汤可以直接喝。
dishes.quote_zh: 只花35块钱就能大口吃新鲜牛肉
dishes.quote_en: Fresh beef by the mouthful for just ¥35.

dishes.what_en: A wild bolete that bruises blue-green when touched. Toxic unless cooked thoroughly; restaurants stir-fry it fresh with green chili.
dishes.what_zh: 一碰就变青的野生牛肝菌，必须彻底炒熟，生吃或凉拌会中毒。
dishes.place_en: A wild-mushroom restaurant that stir-fries to order and forbids takeaway
dishes.place_zh: 现炒野生菌馆，店里到处写着“严禁打包”
dishes.price_note_en: over ¥100 per jin (500 g) of raw mushroom
dishes.verdict_en: Thin slices, slippery and tender, heavily seasoned. Eating it feels like a small adventure with a racing heart.
dishes.verdict_zh: 切得薄，又滑又软，调味重，吃的时候有点心跳的小刺激。
dishes.quote_zh: 奇特的这种口感让人着迷
dishes.quote_en: That strange texture is addictive.

dishes.what_en: Several fresh-fried wild mushrooms (jianshouqing, green-cap, tiger-palm, black bolete) spooned over plain rice.
dishes.what_zh: 见手青、青头菌、虎掌菌、牛肝菌一起拌白米饭。
dishes.verdict_en: Better than the jarred mushroom sauce they buy elsewhere: fresh, fragrant and pure.
dishes.verdict_zh: 比在外地买的云南菌子酱香太多，新鲜现炒，特别纯粹。
dishes.quote_zh: 吃了这一碗，神仙都不换
dishes.quote_en: Wouldn't trade this bowl even with the gods.

dishes.pinyin: qīng tóu jùn / hǔ zhǎng jùn
dishes.what_en: Non-toxic wild mushrooms; green-cap is mild and meaty, tiger-palm is diced and crunchy.
dishes.what_zh: 无毒野生菌，青头菌颗粒大很解馋，虎掌菌切丁脆脆的。
dishes.verdict_en: Tiger-palm eats almost like fatty meat; green-cap's big chunks are the most satisfying.
dishes.verdict_zh: 虎掌菌像在吃肉，青头菌颗粒大最解馋。
dishes.quote_zh: 像吃肉的那种感觉
dishes.quote_en: It's like eating meat.

dishes.what_en: A shallow pot of Guizhou fermented soybeans, bean sprouts and garlic leaves; add crispy pork, pork cracklings, twice-cooked pork or intestine. Spoon it over rice like the locals.
dishes.what_zh: 贵州豆豉、豆芽、蒜苗打底，下酥肉、油渣、回锅肉、肥肠；学本地人直接拌饭。
dishes.place_en: A street of hot-pot shops in old Guiyang
dishes.place_zh: 贵阳老街一整条火锅店
dishes.price_note_zh: 锅底8元+配菜1元+米饭1元随便吃
dishes.verdict_en: Salty at first, then a deep fermented-bean aroma. The crispy pork soaks it all up. 'White goes in, red comes out.'
dishes.verdict_zh: 先咸后回酱豆香；酥肉最吸汁，“白肉进去，红肉出来”。
dishes.quote_zh: 豆豉火锅，它是为米饭服务的
dishes.quote_en: Douchi hot pot exists to serve the rice.

dishes.what_en: Potato slices grilled until crisp outside and soft inside, dipped in one of three sauces: fermented tofu with chili and sesame, crushed peanut, or chili powder.
dishes.what_zh: 土豆片烤到外焦里糯，蘸三种蘸碟：腐乳辣椒芝麻（加折耳根香菜）、花生碎干碟、辣椒面。
dishes.verdict_en: Fragrant, spicy and a little funky from the fermented tofu dip. Very distinctive.
dishes.verdict_zh: 又香又辣又有点小臭，很有自己的特色。
dishes.quote_zh: 又香又辣又有点小臭
dishes.quote_en: Fragrant, spicy and a little stinky.

dishes.what_en: Mold-fermented tofu, grilled on the barbecue. Very pungent.
dishes.what_zh: 长毛发酵的臭豆腐，上烤架烤。
dishes.verdict_en: Seriously stinky: like wet cement and chalk dust. Even the owner's husband avoids it.
dishes.verdict_zh: 确实臭，像砌墙的石灰水里掉进粉笔灰；连老板娘老公都嫌弃。
dishes.quote_zh: 哇，确实臭
dishes.quote_en: Wow. It really does stink.

dishes.what_en: A Miao and Dong specialty: broth made with the partly digested grass from a grass-fed cow's stomach, bitter-green in color, with beef and offal. Dip in chili; eat with rice soaked in the broth.
dishes.what_zh: 苗族侗族特色：用吃草的牛胃里半消化的青草熬汤，汤色黄绿带苦，下牛肉牛杂；蘸辣椒，或用汤泡饭。
dishes.place_en: A niubie hot-pot restaurant in Kaili
dishes.verdict_en: Smells faintly of a barn and tastes like fresh-cut grass with a mild bitterness, less bitter than bitter melon. With chili dip it's a normal, delicious beef hot pot with a sweet finish.
dishes.verdict_zh: 有点牛棚味，吃起来像割过的青草香，微苦但没苦瓜苦；蘸辣椒后就是好吃的牛肉火锅，还会回甜。
dishes.quote_zh: 牛吃的是新鲜青草，我吃的就是新鲜牛瘪
dishes.quote_en: The cow ate fresh grass, so I'm eating fresh niubie.

dishes.what_en: White fermented tofu slowly pan-fried until a thin golden crust forms; inside it's soft like melting ice cream. Dip in fish-mint chili.
dishes.what_zh: 白色发酵豆腐用小平底锅慢煎出金黄薄皮，里面像融化的冰淇淋；蘸折耳根辣椒。
dishes.place_en: Kaili street stall with little frying pans
dishes.place_zh: 凯里街头守着小煎锅的摊
dishes.verdict_en: A thin crisp skin, melt-in-the-mouth inside; mild, not very stinky at all.
dishes.verdict_zh: 外皮薄脆，里面入口即化，没想象中臭。
dishes.quote_zh: 冰激凌一样的质地
dishes.quote_en: A texture like ice cream.

dishes.what_en: Sapie is a Dai cold dish: wrap thin rice noodles and beef in chives, then dunk in a dip. The lime version uses chopped beef, chives, bird's-eye chili and lots of lime juice.
dishes.what_zh: 撒撇是傣族的凉拌蘸食：米线、牛肉卷着蘸水吃；柠檬撒用牛肉碎、韭菜、小米辣，灵魂是柠檬汁。
dishes.verdict_en: Sour, spicy and appetite-whetting, like a cool herbal breeze on a hot afternoon.
dishes.verdict_zh: 酸辣开胃，像炎热夏天吹来一阵带植物香的凉风。
dishes.quote_zh: 非常的酸爽开胃
dishes.quote_en: Wonderfully sour and appetizing.

dishes.en: Bitter sapie (raw beef with bile broth)
dishes.what_en: The 'final exam': raw beef pounded with chives into a paste, mixed with a bitter broth simmered from cattle intestine. Locals drink it for sore throats.
dishes.what_zh: “终极考题”：生牛肉和韭菜捣碎，拌上用牛苦肠熬的苦水；当地人嗓子疼会喝。
dishes.verdict_en: Less bitter than feared, about as bitter as bitter melon, with a sweet aftertaste and a cooling throat.
dishes.verdict_zh: 没有想象中苦，大概苦瓜的程度，会回甜，吃完喉咙清凉。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个苦会回甜
dishes.quote_en: The bitterness turns sweet.

dishes.what_en: An extremely hot local chili you only swish through the dip four or five times; never touch it with your hands.
dishes.what_zh: 极辣的本地辣椒，在蘸水里涮四五下就够；一定用筷子别用手。
dishes.verdict_en: Fragrant heat that hits the tongue within three seconds. Even locals avoid the strongest level.
dishes.verdict_zh: 香辣，三秒钟就到舌尖；最辣那档本地人都不想尝试。
dishes.quote_zh: 三秒钟就可以抵达你的舌尖
dishes.quote_en: It reaches your tongue in three seconds.

dishes.zh: 包烧（豆腐、牛肉）、傣味烤鱼
dishes.what_en: Tofu or beef wrapped in banana leaf with chopped chili and grilled; fish grilled under a thick crust of herbs.
dishes.what_zh: 豆腐或牛肉加小米辣用芭蕉叶包着烧；烤鱼上面铺满厚厚的香料。
dishes.verdict_en: Wrapping keeps the flavor inside; the fish was a favorite.
dishes.verdict_zh: 包烧把味道都留在食物里；烤鱼超好吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个真的好吃
dishes.quote_en: This is really good.

dishes.what_en: Grilled fermented tofu split open and stuffed with chopped zhe'ergen and chili dip. Named for the couples who used to share it.
dishes.what_zh: 烤好的豆腐果掰开，塞折耳根和辣椒蘸水；以前年轻人谈恋爱时一起吃，所以叫恋爱豆腐果。
dishes.verdict_en: The first bite is a shock: fishy, herbal, intense. The second is easier, and by the third you might be hooked.
dishes.verdict_zh: 第一口冲击很大，第二口有了经验，第三口开始期待，像会上瘾。
dishes.quote_zh: 它是一个会让你慢慢上瘾的味道
dishes.quote_en: A taste that slowly gets you hooked.

dishes.en: Barbecue with a mountain of fish-mint dip
dishes.what_en: Tiny skewers brought to your table as they cook; locals fill their dip bowl with zhe'ergen first. Order salted-greens crispy-pork fried rice to finish.
dishes.what_zh: 烤好的小串老板端到桌上；当地人先盛一大碗折耳根放进蘸水；最后点盐菜脆哨炒饭。
dishes.place_zh: 贵阳午饭时间的烧烤摊
dishes.verdict_en: Chewing it with fatty pork belly tames the fishy edge. By the end Mushang was picking out the fish-mint on purpose.
dishes.verdict_zh: 配五花肉一起嚼就没那么冲；最后沐上专门挑折耳根吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 嚼着五花肉吃折耳根，就会冲淡很多折耳根的味道
dishes.quote_en: Eat it with pork belly and the flavor mellows a lot.

dishes.en: Soaked rice-noodle soup with clear beef broth
dishes.what_en: Soft rice noodles (ersi) in clear beef broth with big chunks of beef, then customised at a free bar of 20-plus condiments: sweet soy, fire-roasted chili, garlic oil, Sichuan pepper, mint, sawtooth coriander, fresh lime.
dishes.what_zh: 饵丝配清汤牛肉大块肉，再到调料区自选20多种免费调料：甜酱油、烧辣椒、蒜油、花椒、薄荷、大芫荽、新鲜柠檬。
dishes.place_en: A packed breakfast shop in Mangshi, 12 noodle types to choose from
dishes.place_zh: 芒市人很多的早点铺，主食就有12种
dishes.verdict_en: Everyone's bowl ends up tasting different. Lime, garlic and mint over the beef broth was the hosts' favorite.
dishes.verdict_zh: 每个人调出来的味道都不一样；柠檬、蒜香加薄荷配清汤牛肉最好吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 我调的就是专属于我的味道
dishes.quote_en: What I mixed is a flavor that's all mine.

dishes.what_en: Wild-forest honey cut straight from the comb; only fully capped, mature comb is taken, and only once a year.
dishes.what_zh: 雨林蜂箱里直接割下的蜂巢蜜；只取封盖成熟的部分，一年只收一次。
dishes.place_en: Beekeepers' hives deep in the rainforest outside Mengla
dishes.place_zh: 勐腊县雨林里的蜂农蜂箱
dishes.verdict_en: Super sweet, eaten straight from the comb. Small yields and hard labour explain the price.
dishes.verdict_zh: 抱着蜂巢啃，超级甜；产量少、采收辛苦，所以贵的蜂蜜有原因。
dishes.quote_zh: 超级超级超级甜
dishes.quote_en: Super, super, super sweet.

dishes.what_en: Corn roasted the old way over a wood fire until some kernels burst open.
dishes.what_zh: 用老一辈的柴火烤法烤玉米，玉米粒会烤爆开。
dishes.verdict_en: Charred, crisp and sweet; the burst kernels taste like popcorn.
dishes.verdict_zh: 外面焦脆，有玉米清甜和炭烤香，爆开的粒像爆米花。
dishes.quote_zh: 确实像吃到了那个爆米花
dishes.quote_en: It really is like eating popcorn.

dishes.what_en: Thumb-sized home-grown potatoes, deep-fried with crinkly skin and tossed in a bean-paste chili sauce.
dishes.what_zh: 拇指大的自家小土豆，炸出虎皮，拌豆瓣辣酱。
dishes.verdict_en: Thin crisp skin, soft and fragrant inside.
dishes.verdict_zh: 外面一层薄皮炸得酥，里面糯糯软软香香的。
dishes.quote_zh: 里面是那种糯糯软软香香的
dishes.quote_en: Soft, fluffy and fragrant inside.

dishes.what_en: A Chuxiong specialty: air-dried beef and whole chicken smoked over a bed of pine needles, then grilled, served on banana leaf with a sour-spicy Dai dip.
dishes.what_zh: 楚雄特色：风干牛肉和整鸡先在松针上熏，再上架烤，垫芭蕉叶，蘸傣味酸辣料。
dishes.place_en: Smoky stall at the market, run by a Han-Dai family from Chuxiong
dishes.place_zh: 集市上楚雄人开的松毛烧烤摊
dishes.verdict_en: Chewy, spicy beef with a faint pine scent. The chicken tastes like cured, smoked and roast chicken at once. Seasoning runs salty.
dishes.verdict_zh: 牛肉有嚼劲，原味就很辣，有松针清香；烤鸡综合了腊鸡、熏鸡和烤鸡的味道；整体偏咸。
dishes.quote_zh: 有一种松针小小的清香
dishes.quote_en: There's a faint, fresh scent of pine.

dishes.what_en: Rice noodles smothered in warm, silky yellow-pea porridge, with a dozen self-serve toppings and sauces.
dishes.what_zh: 米线浇上豌豆磨成的稀豆粉，十几种配料自己加。
dishes.place_en: Morning food stall inside a Baoshan wet market
dishes.place_zh: 保山菜市场里的早餐摊
dishes.verdict_en: Gentle pea sweetness; the joy is the texture: soft, slippery and slurpable.
dishes.verdict_zh: 有点豆子清甜，最爽的是口感：又糯又软又滑，呼噜呼噜吸进嘴。
dishes.quote_zh: 一下子就打开食欲
dishes.quote_en: It wakes your appetite right up.

dishes.what_en: A rice-cake (erkuai) disc toasted over charcoal until it puffs, brushed with a dozen sauces (fire-roasted chili, green chili, sesame, Sichuan pepper oil, peanuts) and rolled around potato shreds or sausage.
dishes.what_zh: 饵块放炭火上烤鼓，刷十几种酱（烧辣椒、青椒酱、芝麻油、花椒油、花生碎），可卷洋芋丝、火腿肠。
dishes.place_en: Stall next to the pea-noodle shop
dishes.verdict_en: Chewy like rice cake; it's all about the sauces.
dishes.verdict_zh: 像年糕一样软糯，主要吃酱料的味道。
dishes.quote_zh: 它的调味料都巨多
dishes.quote_en: There's a crazy number of sauces.

dishes.what_en: Unripe mango, pineapple, strawberries and local sour fruits tossed in fire-roasted chili, sugar, salt and MSG.
dishes.what_zh: 不熟的芒果、菠萝、草莓和本地酸果，拌烧辣椒、糖、盐、味精。
dishes.verdict_en: Sweet, sour, salty and spicy at once. Locals pick unripe fruit on purpose.
dishes.verdict_zh: 又甜又酸又咸又辣；当地人专挑不熟的酸水果蘸辣。
dishes.quote_zh: 又甜，又酸，又咸，又辣
dishes.quote_en: Sweet, sour, salty and spicy all at once.

dishes.what_en: Pot-cooked rice under a pile of chili-based dishes, plus a big fried drumstick soaked in chili oil.
dishes.what_zh: 锅煮米饭盖满各种辣椒菜，再加一只浸满油辣子的炸鸡腿。
dishes.place_en: A famous, always-queued chili-rice canteen in Baoshan
dishes.place_zh: 保山排长队的有名辣子饭
dishes.verdict_en: The drumstick is crisp outside and sweet inside. Get two. The chili dishes run salty, so eat them with plenty of rice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 鸡腿外焦里鲜甜，一定加一个；辣子菜做得咸，必须配米饭。
dishes.quote_zh: 我馋死这个鸡腿了
dishes.quote_en: I'm dying for this drumstick.

dishes.what_en: Coffee grown on the Nujiang (Salween) valley slopes, brewed strong at a roadside stall by the farmer who grew it.
dishes.what_zh: 怒江边潞江坝种的咖啡，咖啡农在路边摊自己煮，很浓。
dishes.place_en: Roadside café on the Lujiangba road
dishes.place_zh: 潞江坝公路边的咖啡馆
dishes.verdict_en: Very strong, as only a grower would brew it.
dishes.verdict_zh: 太浓了，只有自己种的才敢这么喝。
dishes.quote_zh: 正宗的保山咖啡
dishes.quote_en: Authentic Baoshan coffee.

dishes.what_en: Braised beef and offal in a red-oil copper pot kept bubbling over charcoal; add mountain potatoes, fried 'pocket' tofu and erkuai rice cakes. Eat with pickled greens.
dishes.what_zh: 红油铜锅炭火炖牛肉牛杂，下高山洋芋、口袋豆腐、饵块，配酸腌菜。
dishes.place_en: Copper-pot beef restaurant (Baoshan claims the dish's origin)
dishes.place_zh: 铜锅牛肉店（据说保山是发源地）
dishes.verdict_en: Firm, well-braised beef, mildly spicy. The sour pickles make every bite better, and the fried tofu soaks up the broth.
dishes.verdict_zh: 牛肉紧实入味，微辣；配酸腌菜更爽口，口袋豆腐吸满汤汁。
dishes.quote_zh: 每一口都想配上这个酸腌菜
dishes.quote_en: Every bite wants a bit of those pickles.

dishes.zh: 缅甸青蟹（清蒸 + 香辣）
dishes.en: Myanmar mud crab, steamed and spicy-fried
dishes.what_en: Mud crabs trucked in from the Indian Ocean via the nearby Myanmar border, sold by the basin. Steamed (dip in wasabi soy or bird's-eye chili soy) or stir-fried with chili, local herbs, potato and onion.
dishes.what_zh: 从印度洋经缅甸口岸运来的青蟹，论盆吃；清蒸蘸芥末酱油或小米辣酱油，或用本地辣椒香料加土豆洋葱香辣炒。
dishes.place_en: A small back-alley crab shop in Mangshi (locals say flashy big restaurants aren't better)
dishes.place_zh: 芒市小巷子里的螃蟹店（当地人说装修亮的大店不一定好吃）
dishes.price_note_en: about ¥30–50/jin wholesale; ¥78 at the restaurant, versus ¥100+ elsewhere in China
dishes.price_note_zh: 批发30～50元一斤，店里78，国内其他地方至少100多
dishes.verdict_en: Every steamed crab is full of roe and dense, slightly sweet meat. The spicy version soaks the sauce into the body meat and bursts with juice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 每个壳里都有蟹黄，肉紧实带甜；香辣的汤汁吃进蟹肉里，一口爆汁。
dishes.quote_zh: 我第一次吃这么大口的黄
dishes.quote_en: First time I've had a mouthful of roe this big.

dishes.what_en: Bring meat bought from the market butcher; the stall marinates it with local spices and you grill it over a low charcoal basin, then dip it in a dry chili-salt mix.
dishes.what_zh: 自己从肉铺买肉，交给烧烤摊抓拌腌制，在炭盆铁架上自己烤，蘸干碟（味精、盐、干辣椒面）。
dishes.place_en: Morning barbecue hall at the Yuanyang market, under a big white canopy
dishes.place_zh: 元阳集市白色大棚下的炭盆烧烤区
dishes.price_note_en: ¥10 per person processing fee, any amount of meat; beef ~¥50/jin
dishes.price_note_zh: 每人10元加工费，肉随便买；牛肉约50元一斤
dishes.verdict_en: The pork was butchered that morning, so it tastes intensely fresh. The basin sits close to the meat, which gives everything a deep, smoky flavor.
dishes.verdict_zh: 当天现杀的猪肉特别鲜，离炭近，味道特别浓郁。
dishes.quote_zh: 我第一次吃这么鲜的猪肝
dishes.quote_en: I've never had pork liver this fresh.

dishes.what_en: Small, slightly funky fermented tofu that puffs up on the grill and turns soft inside.
dishes.what_zh: 带一点臭味的发酵小豆腐，烤到里面软软的。
dishes.place_en: Same barbecue hall, free with the processing fee
dishes.place_zh: 同一个烧烤区，加工费里含
dishes.verdict_en: Endless free refills. Good, especially the slightly stinkier ones.
dishes.verdict_zh: 豆腐无限续，偏臭一点的更好吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 真是豆腐无限续，太爽了
dishes.quote_en: Unlimited tofu refills. Heaven.

dishes.what_en: Lard-glossed sticky rice wrapped around crispy pork bits (cuishao), pickles, potato and chili; sprinkle with sugar if you like.
dishes.what_zh: 猪油裹着的糯米包脆哨、酸菜、洋芋、辣椒，可以撒白糖。
dishes.price_note_en: ¥5 small, ¥10 with extra rice and cuishao
dishes.verdict_en: Rich but not greasy. Every bite is different: sour, then sweet, then spicy. Like opening a blind box.
dishes.verdict_zh: 不油腻反而清爽；每一口味道都不一样，像开盲盒。
dishes.quote_zh: 吃糯米饭就像跟开盲盒一样
dishes.quote_en: Eating it is like opening a blind box.

dishes.what_en: Springy, almost crunchy egg noodles under a dozen toppings: pig intestine, blood tofu, crispy pork, all in red chili oil. Locals even have it with a morning drink.
dishes.what_zh: 偏脆的鸡蛋面，盖十几种浇头：肥肠、血旺、脆哨，全浸在红油里；本地人早上还会配酒。
dishes.place_en: An old noodle shop where retired veterans gather each morning
dishes.place_zh: 退休老兵每天早上聚会的老面馆
dishes.verdict_en: A noodle texture they'd never had, snappy rather than chewy. Heavy for breakfast, and it's all about the toppings.
dishes.verdict_zh: 第一次吃到这种偏脆的面；早上吃有点重口，重点是浇头的滋味。
dishes.quote_zh: 更多的是吃这个配料的滋味
dishes.quote_en: It's more about the toppings than the noodles.

dishes.what_en: Guizhou's fermented tomato-and-chili sour soup as a hot-pot base; choose mild, medium or extra sour. Cook ash-cured tofu, rice tofu, meatballs and crispy pork, and finish with rice noodles.
dishes.what_zh: 贵州发酵番茄辣椒做的红酸汤锅底，分微酸、中酸、特酸；下灰豆腐、米豆腐、丸子、酥肉，最后下粉。
dishes.place_en: A sour-soup hot-pot restaurant in a Zunyi alley
dishes.place_zh: 遵义巷子里的酸汤火锅店
dishes.verdict_en: Medium sour is the local default. The owner's lemon slice gives it a fruity lift; the ash tofu bursts with soup.
dishes.verdict_zh: 本地人一般吃中酸；老板加一片柠檬提果香；灰豆腐的孔里吸满酸汤，一咬就爆。
dishes.quote_zh: 这酸爽无人能挡
dishes.quote_en: Nothing beats this tangy kick.

dishes.what_en: A ¥5 bowl from a one-person stall, loaded with pickled ginger beans, sour radish and peanuts.
dishes.what_zh: 一个人看摊的5块钱酸辣粉，加酸豇豆、酸萝卜、花生米。
dishes.place_en: A tiny stall in a Zunyi back alley
dishes.verdict_en: Absurdly generous for ¥5: the owner kept adding more.
dishes.verdict_zh: 5块钱给这么多，老板还一直加。
dishes.quote_zh: 五块钱这么多
dishes.quote_en: All this for five yuan?

dishes.what_en: Mixed wild mushrooms weighed in front of you, then simmered in chicken broth on a timer (about 20 minutes) before anyone may eat. Dip in peanut-sesame-chili with fermented tofu oil.
dishes.what_zh: 当面称好的杂菌下鸡汤锅，计时约20分钟才能吃；蘸水有花生芝麻辣椒面和油腐乳。
dishes.place_en: A building full of mushroom restaurants in a county about 50 minutes from Kunming
dishes.place_zh: 昆明市区开车50分钟的县里，一整栋楼都是菌子馆
dishes.verdict_en: The broth feels thick in the mouth from all the umami. Every mushroom has a different bite, from fatty-soft to crunchy.
dishes.verdict_zh: 汤在嘴里是厚的，鲜到不知道该说什么；不同菌子口感完全不同。
dishes.quote_zh: 云南人你们真的从小都吃这么好吗
dishes.quote_en: Yunnan folks, have you really eaten this well your whole lives?

dishes.what_en: Fried rice with ganba, a prized, chewy, intensely aromatic Yunnan wild fungus.
dishes.what_zh: 加了云南名贵野生菌“干巴菌”的炒饭，口感紧实越嚼越香。
dishes.verdict_en: The dish they were most excited for. It gets more fragrant the longer you chew.
dishes.verdict_zh: 最期待的一道，越嚼越香。
dishes.quote_zh: 它是越嚼越香
dishes.quote_en: The more you chew, the better it gets.

dishes.what_en: The most toxic edible bolete on the menu, stir-fried hot and spicy.
dishes.what_zh: 全场最“毒”的红见手青，香辣炒。
dishes.verdict_en: Silky and fresh; the chili suits the mushroom perfectly. Pile it on rice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 口感丝滑很鲜，辣和菌子很搭，盖饭更香。
dishes.quote_zh: 每次吃见手青都有种心跳的感觉
dishes.quote_en: Every time I eat jianshouqing my heart races.

dishes.what_en: Rice noodles cooked one pot at a time in a small clay pot with braised pork sauce and fresh meat; add an egg. Thick, thin or flat (erkuai) noodles.
dishes.what_zh: 小砂锅一锅一锅单煮，放肉酱和鲜肉；可选粗米线、细米线、饵丝，一定要加蛋。
dishes.place_en: A 30-year-old neighbourhood shop with eight burners, a local viewer's childhood favourite
dishes.place_zh: 小区旁开了30年的老店，八个小炉灶，网友从小吃到大
dishes.verdict_en: Bone-broth base with lots of pork sauce. Smooth and silky, and still bubbling hot when it reaches you.
dishes.verdict_zh: 骨汤鲜味加肉酱，爽滑，端上来一直冒热气。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个米线很好吃，它就是爽滑
dishes.quote_en: These noodles are great: so smooth.

dishes.what_en: Cold brown-sugar water with soft sticky rice, red dates, candied shreds and a spoon of rose jam.
dishes.what_zh: 红糖水加稀糯米饭、红枣、红绿丝和一勺玫瑰酱。
dishes.verdict_en: The recommended pairing: refreshing brown sugar against hot noodles.
dishes.verdict_zh: 推荐搭配，红糖爽口。
dishes.quote_zh: 红糖爽口
dishes.quote_en: Refreshing brown sugar.

dishes.what_en: Bee larvae, bamboo worms, cicadas, scorpions and centipedes, deep-fried and dusted with chili.
dishes.what_zh: 蜂蛹、竹虫、蝉、蝎子、蜈蚣等，油炸后撒辣椒面。
dishes.verdict_en: Scorpion is crisp like crayfish shell; the centipede is slightly bitter inside. For the brave.
dishes.verdict_zh: 蝎子像小龙虾壳，炸得香；蜈蚣里面微苦，看个人喜好。
dishes.quote_zh: 云南会动的都是蛋白质
dishes.quote_en: In Yunnan, anything that moves is protein.

dishes.what_en: Jizong grows from termite nests half a metre underground; torn by hand, its flesh is like chicken and the broth tastes like a long-simmered hen soup.
dishes.what_zh: 鸡枞长在地下50厘米的白蚁窝上，用手撕不用刀，口感像鸡肉，汤像熬出来的老母鸡汤。
dishes.place_en: Campfire cooking on a hillside in Mouding, with mushrooms bought at the local market
dishes.place_zh: 牟定山上露营地现做，鸡枞在当地菌子市场买的
dishes.verdict_en: So savory they say existing words can't describe it. 'Dangerously' good.
dishes.verdict_zh: 鲜到以前的形容词都不够用，“危险”的好喝。
dishes.quote_zh: 怎么会这么鲜
dishes.quote_en: How can it be this savory?

dishes.en: Ganba mushroom & Yunnan ham fried rice
dishes.pinyin: gān bā jùn huǒ tuǐ chǎo fàn
dishes.what_en: Shredded ganba fungus fried with cured ham and rice; the frilly mushroom soaks up the ham fat.
dishes.what_zh: 干巴菌撕成小块和火腿、米饭一起炒，褶皱吸满腊肉香。
dishes.verdict_en: Everyone grabbed for it the moment it left the wok.
dishes.verdict_zh: 一出锅大家就蜂拥而上。
dishes.quote_zh: 它吸了好多腊肉的香味
dishes.quote_en: It soaked up so much of the ham's flavor.

dishes.what_en: Fresh matsutake (found after an hour's search) and jizong sliced raw, or pan-fried in a little oil.
dishes.what_zh: 找了一个小时才找到的松茸和鸡枞，切片生吃，或油煎。
dishes.verdict_en: Matsutake starts clean and finishes woody, like the forest floor; pan-fried it turns sweet.
dishes.verdict_zh: 松茸前调清香，尾调是木质、像落叶地上的味道；油煎后很甜。
dishes.quote_zh: 一嘴鸡枞一嘴松茸，太极致了
dishes.quote_en: A bite of jizong, a bite of matsutake: the ultimate.

dishes.what_en: Sweet sticky rice baked inside a hollowed pineapple.
dishes.what_zh: 在掏空的菠萝里蒸的甜糯米饭。
dishes.place_en: Weekend village market (ganbai) in a Dai village
dishes.verdict_en: Sweet with a hint of honey, then a little spicy at the end. The students cleared it.
dishes.verdict_zh: 微香微甜，有蜂蜜味，最后有一点辣，绝了。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个菠萝饭绝了
dishes.quote_en: This pineapple rice is incredible.

dishes.what_en: Sticky rice (here with peanuts) roasted inside a bamboo section, then shaved open.
dishes.what_zh: 糯米加花生塞进竹筒里烤，现场削开。
dishes.verdict_en: Faintly salty and smells of bamboo.
dishes.verdict_zh: 淡淡的竹香，有咸味。
dishes.quote_zh: 淡淡的竹筒有咸味的
dishes.quote_en: A faint bamboo aroma and a little salt.

dishes.en: Steamed rice sheets with free mint
dishes.what_en: Steamed rice-noodle sheets with tomato sauce, chili paste and fish-mint dressing. Mint is piled up free for everyone.
dishes.what_zh: 蒸好的米粉皮，配番茄酱、辣酱、折耳根料水，薄荷无限量。
dishes.verdict_en: Mint makes the broth taste fresher. In Yunnan villages mint is a vegetable, not a garnish.
dishes.verdict_zh: 泡了薄荷汤汁特别鲜；寨子里薄荷是当青菜吃的。
dishes.quote_zh: 薄荷是可以当青菜吃的
dishes.quote_en: Here mint counts as a vegetable.

dishes.what_en: Village chicken grilled over charcoal with aromatic herbs rather than chili.
dishes.what_zh: 炭火烤的寨子鸡，用香料而不是辣椒调味。
dishes.verdict_en: Smoky, fragrant and seasoned with unfamiliar herbs. A taste you won't find in tourist spots.
dishes.verdict_zh: 有炭火味，香料辣椒，陌生又好吃的香味，跟景区吃的不一样。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个烤鸡有炭火味
dishes.quote_en: You can taste the charcoal in this chicken.

dishes.what_en: A Guizhou-style hot pot: the owner stir-fries chili, Sichuan pepper, garlic and fermented beans at your table, adds water, then pork ribs and free-range chicken go in.
dishes.what_zh: 贵州豆豉火锅：老板在桌上现炒辣椒、花椒、蒜、豆豉，加水煮排骨和本地土鸡。
dishes.place_en: Night market stall run by a Guizhou family in Mengla
dishes.place_zh: 勐腊夜市一家贵州人开的火锅
dishes.verdict_en: Sour, spicy, savory and fragrant; the broth gets richer the longer it boils. The local free-range chicken is very firm.
dishes.verdict_zh: 酸辣鲜香，越煮越浓越香，本地土鸡肉特别紧实。
dishes.quote_zh: 每一个来勐腊的人都应该吃这个
dishes.quote_en: Everyone who comes to Mengla should eat this.

dishes.what_en: A domed pan greased with a slab of pork fat: pork belly and beef grill on the dome ('cattle climbing the mountain') while the fat runs down into the broth moat for shrimp, taro and greens. Dip in house-made Lao paste.
dishes.what_zh: 用一大块肥油润锅，五花肉、牛肉在凸起的“山”上烤（牛上山），油流进下面一圈汤里涮虾、芋头和菜；蘸老挝师傅自制的老挝酱。
dishes.place_en: A Laotian hot-pot shop in Mengla
dishes.verdict_en: Heavy, salty-spicy Lao paste; beef rolled in fresh mint is the standout. Like being in Laos.
dishes.verdict_zh: 老挝酱咸辣口重；牛肉卷薄荷绝了；在40度的西双版纳喝着老挝啤酒，像到了老挝。
dishes.quote_zh: 牛肉卷薄荷，绝了
dishes.quote_en: Beef wrapped in mint: perfect.

dishes.what_en: Fermented pork sausage-style meat, sweet-salty and a little spicy and tart, cooked on the hot-pot dome.
dishes.what_zh: 发酵的酸肉，甜咸带点辣和酸，放在锅上烤。
dishes.verdict_en: Sweet and salty with a gentle sourness; Yunnan's border flavors lean sour.
dishes.verdict_zh: 甜咸带辣，轻轻的酸；云南口味偏酸。
dishes.quote_zh: 云南的口味就是偏酸
dishes.quote_en: Yunnan flavors lean sour.

dishes.what_en: Long local green chilies charred directly over flame, peeled, then mashed with eggplant and tomatoes.
dishes.what_zh: 细长的本地青椒直接用火烧，撕皮，和茄子、小番茄拌在一起。
dishes.verdict_en: Smoky and fresh, not especially hot: pure chili flavor that wakes up your mouth.
dishes.verdict_zh: 焦香、青椒本味，没那么辣，一口唤醒口腔。
dishes.quote_zh: 真的是辣椒的本味
dishes.quote_en: This is chili's true flavor.

dishes.what_en: Beef shreds stir-fried several times with house-made zao lajiao: local chilies fermented for a month, made once a year around September.
dishes.what_zh: 牛肉丝和自制糟辣椒反复爆炒；糟辣椒用九月左右的本地辣椒，一年做一次，发酵一个月。
dishes.place_en: A small restaurant beside a mahjong hall; its signature dish
dishes.place_zh: 麻将馆旁的小馆子，镇店之宝
dishes.verdict_en: Salty, bright and a little fermented; every strand of beef is coated. Begs for rice.
dishes.verdict_zh: 偏咸，有辣椒的鲜香和一点发酵酱香，每丝牛肉都挂满糟辣椒，超下饭。
dishes.quote_zh: 吃的就是这个糟辣椒的味道
dishes.quote_en: It's all about that fermented chili.

dishes.what_en: Mountains of local green chilies wok-fried until fragrant, then pressure-cooked chicken added to soak up the juice.
dishes.what_zh: 大量本地青椒大火炒香，再加高压锅炖好的鸡块，让鸡肉吸满青椒香。
dishes.place_en: Same restaurant (only medium or hot, no mild option)
dishes.place_zh: 同一家店（只有中辣和辣，没有微辣）
dishes.verdict_en: Juicy thick chilies, fresh and green; the heat keeps building.
dishes.verdict_zh: 辣椒肉厚还有汁，青涩鲜香，辣度持续升温。
dishes.quote_zh: 这个辣椒它会持续性的升温
dishes.quote_en: The heat just keeps climbing.

dishes.what_en: Rice noodles blanched in a giant cauldron of mutton broth, topped with red chili oil and coarse fried chili, plus a bowl of charred 'burnt' chili on the table. Dunk the fried pastry cakes in the soup.
dishes.what_zh: 大锅羊肉汤烫粉，浇红油和粗辣椒面，桌上还有一碗烤得发黑的糊辣椒；配油炸小饼蘸汤吃。
dishes.place_en: A busy mutton-noodle shop in Zunyi
dishes.verdict_en: The red oil is fragrant rather than fiery; the broth is so fresh it outshines the noodles. The charred chili is the hook.
dishes.verdict_zh: 红油不是很辣而是香，汤鲜得远超粉本身；炒糊的糊辣椒最勾人。
dishes.quote_zh: 重点要吃这个辣椒
dishes.quote_en: The real point is the chili.

dishes.what_en: Chicken simmered and stir-fried with Zunyi's fermented chili until the oil and sauce cook down; a back-alley kitchen runs a dozen woks at once.
dishes.what_zh: 用遵义辣椒把鸡炒到油和料汁收干，巷子深处的店十几口锅同时翻炒。
dishes.place_en: A back-alley spicy-chicken restaurant near the market
dishes.place_zh: 菜市场巷子深处的辣子鸡店
dishes.verdict_en: Smoky, fragrant chili; order at least medium spicy. Locals swear it isn't hot.
dishes.verdict_zh: 辣椒焦香，必须中辣起步；当地人说真的不辣。
dishes.quote_zh: 遵义辣子鸡必须中辣起步
dishes.quote_en: Zunyi spicy chicken starts at medium heat, minimum.

dishes.what_en: Every part of the chicken (thigh, wing, gizzard, heart, skin) grilled over charcoal, served on a table with a heater underneath, with a chili dip and a red-oil 'qiangchang'.
dishes.what_zh: 鸡的各个部位（腿、翅、胗、心、皮）炭火烤，桌下有炉子保温，蘸辣椒，配泼油的呛肠。
dishes.place_en: A grilled-chicken street in an old factory district, a holdover from factory-worker suppers
dishes.place_zh: 老化工厂区的烤鸡街，当年工人下班的夜宵
dishes.verdict_en: Smoky juices in every strand. Always eat it with the skin on and dipped in chili.
dishes.verdict_zh: 肉丝里都是炭香和鸡汁；一定要裹着鸡皮、蘸着辣椒吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 一定要蘸着辣椒吃，一定要裹着鸡皮吃
dishes.quote_en: Always with chili, always with the skin.

dishes.what_en: Pour-over-style coffee from a stall beside the market, with good packaging and floral, wine-like notes.
dishes.what_zh: 菜市场旁的精品咖啡，包装精致，有花香和红酒感。
dishes.place_en: A coffee stall beside a Zunyi wet market
dishes.place_zh: 遵义菜市场旁的咖啡摊
dishes.verdict_en: Surprisingly sophisticated for ¥6; pair it with sticky rice from next door.
dishes.verdict_zh: 6块钱的咖啡很洋气，配隔壁的糯米饭。
dishes.quote_zh: 这咖啡老咖了
dishes.quote_en: This coffee is seriously good.

dishes.what_en: Whole fish grilled over charcoal, stuffed and coated with fine chili powder, then coarse chili, then a final ladle of chili oil, with a few mint leaves on top.
dishes.what_zh: 整鱼炭烤，里外撒细辣椒面、粗辣椒面，上桌前再浇一大勺油辣椒，最后放点薄荷。
dishes.verdict_en: A mouthful of seasoning; the fried chili oil sticks to the skin and smells amazing. Not 'not spicy', whatever the auntie says.
dishes.verdict_zh: 满嘴都是料，炸过的油辣椒糊在鱼皮上特别香；阿姨说不辣，其实很辣。
dishes.quote_zh: 谁说不辣的啊
dishes.quote_en: Who said it wasn't spicy?!

dishes.zh: 辣椒蛋炒饭 / 炒米皮
dishes.en: Chili egg fried rice / fried rice noodles
dishes.what_en: The two classic Guizhou late-night finishers: rice fried with egg and fermented chili (chili pieces bigger than the egg), or stir-fried rice-noodle sheets.
dishes.what_zh: 贵州夜宵两大收尾：糟辣椒蛋炒饭（辣椒比鸡蛋颗粒还大），或炒米皮。
dishes.verdict_en: Each host defended a different one. Both are worth ordering.
dishes.verdict_zh: 两位主播各投一票，都值得点。
dishes.quote_zh: 炒米皮真的好吃
dishes.quote_en: The fried rice noodles are really good.

dishes.en: Tiny grilled tofu around a stove
dishes.what_en: One woman, one little charcoal stove: small tofu cubes grilled in front of you and dipped in numbing chili powder.
dishes.what_zh: 一个阿姨一个小炉子，现烤小豆腐，蘸麻麻的辣椒面。
dishes.verdict_en: Tender inside with strong soy flavor; sitting at the stove is half the fun.
dishes.verdict_zh: 里面好嫩，豆香浓，辣椒面好吃；坐下就很开心。
dishes.quote_zh: 如果大家来到贵州一定要尝一下
dishes.quote_en: If you come to Guizhou, you have to try this.

dishes.what_en: Tiny pork skewers grilled to order and showered in chili powder; another stall serves crispier ones with a fish-mint dip.
dishes.what_zh: 现烤小猪肉串撒辣椒面；另一家烤得更焦，配折耳根蘸水。
dishes.verdict_en: Tender with a little fat, not greasy.
dishes.verdict_zh: 嫩嫩的，带点肥肉但不腻。
dishes.quote_zh: 不会有那种特别腻的感觉
dishes.quote_en: Not greasy at all.

dishes.what_en: Egg beaten with minced pork and cooked inside its shell on the grill, like a savory custard.
dishes.what_zh: 鸡蛋加肉末在蛋壳里烤，像蛋花羹。
dishes.verdict_en: No eggy smell; fragrant from the pork.
dishes.verdict_zh: 没有蛋腥味，加了肉末很香。
dishes.quote_zh: 还有点香香的
dishes.quote_en: Nicely fragrant.

dishes.what_en: Sweet-sour juice boiled from yangmei (Chinese bayberry), served ice-cold. The standard late-night pairing for spicy snacks.
dishes.what_zh: 杨梅煮的酸甜汁，加冰，是夜宵标配。
dishes.verdict_en: Cuts through chili and heat. A Kaili summer essential.
dishes.verdict_zh: 解辣解腻，夏天超级爽。
dishes.quote_zh: 冰杨梅汁是夜宵的标配
dishes.quote_en: Iced bayberry juice is the late-night standard.

dishes.what_en: Two meat dishes and two vegetable dishes with rice, cooked in the school canteen.
dishes.what_zh: 学校食堂两荤两素配米饭。
dishes.verdict_en: Tasty, with a clearly Yunnan flavor. Refills are allowed and everyone wolfs it down.
dishes.verdict_zh: 很可口，很有云南风味，不够还能再打。
dishes.quote_zh: 很可口，很有云南的风味
dishes.quote_en: Really tasty, very Yunnan.

dishes.what_en: Fruit picked straight from the family's own trees, eaten by the basin.
dishes.what_zh: 同学家树上直接摘的水果，用脸盆装着吃。
dishes.verdict_en: So fresh. Yunnan fruit is fantastic.
dishes.verdict_zh: 好鲜，云南的水果真好吃。
dishes.quote_zh: 云南的水果真好吃
dishes.quote_en: Yunnan fruit is so good.

videos.title_zh: Yunnan这是“中国最魔幻农村”！| 当100个研究生回村种地......【盗月社】
videos.title_en: "China's most magical village"! | When 100 graduate students return to the village to farm...
videos.summary_en: In Gusheng village beside Erhai Lake in Dali, the hosts meet some of the 300 graduate students and professors who live in the village year-round, working on irrigation, compost, lake protection and helping smallholder farmers. A documentary episode rather than a food one.
videos.summary_zh: 在大理洱海边的古生村，主播认识了常年驻村的300多名研究生、博士和导师：做节水灌溉、垃圾堆肥、洱海保护、帮小农户。这一期是纪录片性质，没有美食点评。

videos.title_zh: 在云南小城体验到了烧烤的神仙吃法！刚上菜就把我看懵了……【盗月社】
videos.title_en: I experienced the immortal way of eating barbecue in a small town in Yunnan!【Daoyueshe】
videos.summary_en: First night in Mangshi for the Water-Splashing Festival: after a day of being soaked, the hosts learn that Yunnan barbecue gives every ingredient its own dip, from a mint-and-oil dish sizzled right on the grill for beef to fermented radish-leaf paste for pork belly and a red-oil bath for puffed tofu.
videos.summary_zh: 泼水节来到芒市的第一晚，泼了一天水后吃云南烧烤：每样食材配一种蘸碟，牛肉放在炭火上的薄荷油碟里滚，五花肉配腌菜膏，包浆豆腐泡进红油蘸碟。

videos.title_zh: Guizhou辣椒魔鬼量！到了贵州才知道，粉是可以这么吃的！又臭又香的特色火锅，25一锅，吃得根本停不下来！【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Lots of chili peppers involved! A special way to eat Guizhou rice noodles! And 25CNY for a hot pot!
videos.summary_en: Escaping Shanghai's rainy season to Liupanshui, Guizhou's 'cool capital' at 16–18°C in summer: a dozen mutton-noodle shops in one lane, a ¥25 stir-fried fermented-bean hot pot that smells funky but tastes great, misty grasslands, and a mountain full of laoguo griddle restaurants beside an old coal mine.
videos.summary_zh: 逃离上海梅雨来到贵州“凉都”六盘水（夏天16–18度）：一条小巷十几家羊肉粉、闻着臭吃着香的25元豆豉火锅、雨雾里的草原，以及老煤矿旁满山的烙锅。

videos.title_zh: 离谱！带大学生0元去云南边境旅行，没想到落地就被扔河里…【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Unbelievable! Took college students on a free trip to Yunnan, got dumped in a river on day one!
videos.summary_en: Day one of the hosts' free trip for four college students to Mengla, on the Laos border in Xishuangbanna: rice-noodle breakfast with a basin of pork bones, the rainforest canopy walkway at Wangtianshu, a Dai feast laid out on banana leaves, a Laotian hot pot, and a village Water-Splashing Festival.
videos.summary_zh: 带四个大学生免费去西双版纳勐腊（挨着老挝）的第一天：米干配一大盆猪棒骨、望天树空中走廊、铺在芭蕉叶上的傣味宴、老挝火锅，还有寨子里原汁原味的泼水节。

videos.title_zh: 云南特色名吃“傣味手抓饭”，188元10道菜，第一次体验就出糗了...【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Yunnan food "hand pilaf", 10 dishes for 188 RMB, the first experience was embarrassing...
videos.summary_en: The channel's stand-in duo (Zhu Feifei and Coco) order a Dai-style hand-grab platter: about ten dishes served on a woven bamboo tray for ¥188. They work through spicy pineapple, coriander-heavy salads, potato mash, pineapple rice and lemongrass-stuffed grilled fish, then realise at the end they should have been eating with their hands.
videos.summary_zh: 代班的 coffee 组合吃傣味手抓饭：188元十道菜装在簸箕里，凉拌菠萝、香菜鬼鸡、酸菜土豆泥、菠萝饭、香茅草烤鱼，吃到最后才想起来要用手抓。

videos.title_zh: Guizhou这个贵州五线小城，凭什么是中国“吃商”最高的城市？【盗月社 | 贵州安顺】
videos.title_en: 【Eng Sub】Why is this small town in Guizhou with the highest "eating IQ" in China?
videos.summary_en: Nineteen meals in three days in Anshun, a small Guizhou city the hosts crown China's highest 'eating IQ'. All-you-can-eat grilled intestines for ¥36.8, a whole street of potato cakes and rice-skin rolls, a morning market, puffed pig-trotter sour-soup pot, wild-herb bean hot pot, and a teenage barbecue 'boy band'.
videos.summary_zh: 在贵州五线小城安顺三天吃了19顿：36块8自助烤小肠、满街的洋芋粑和丝娃娃式米皮、早上的集市、灌汤猪脚酸汤锅、野菜豆米火锅，还有一群19岁小伙开的“男团烧烤”。

videos.title_zh: 当我相信了云南人的简单吃一点...【盗月社 | 云南蒙自】
videos.title_en: When I believed a local in Yunnan when they said "let's just grab a quick bite"... | Daoyueshe | ...
videos.summary_en: In Mengzi, near the Vietnam border and the claimed birthplace of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, the hosts order the ¥20 and ¥50 tiers. The ¥50 bowl holds 17 kinds of meat, and a local teaches them to load it with fresh chili oil.
videos.summary_zh: 在中越边境的蒙自（过桥米线发源地），主播点了20元和50元两档。50元那碗有17种肉料，本地大哥教他们加刚炸好的油辣子。

videos.title_zh: 贵州超横自助！35元牛肉牛杂无限续！酸爽爆汗汤底都喝了…【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Great buffet in Guizhou! The 35 yuan beef offal can be refilled indefinitely!
videos.summary_en: Zhu Feifei and Coco's 'wow tour' of Kaili goes wrong all day (a chili-roasting stall gone, a usually packed tofu shop half empty) but ends happily at a ¥35 all-you-can-eat fresh-beef hot pot with red sour soup. Earlier: a ¥18 afternoon platter of siwawa wraps with 24 little dishes.
videos.summary_zh: coffee 组合在凯里的“哇塞之旅”一路不顺（烤辣椒的摊没了、平时爆满的豆腐店人不多），最后在35元鲜牛肉自助酸汤锅找回好心情；之前还吃了24个小碗的丝娃娃。

videos.title_zh: 每年都有人中毒，为什么云南人还要吃见手青？【盗月社 | 云南】
videos.title_en: 每年都有人中毒，为什么云南人还要吃见手青？【盗月社 | 云南】
videos.summary_en: In wild-mushroom season the hosts hunt for a Yunnan restaurant that still serves the notoriously toxic jianshouqing (Lanmaoa asiatica), learn why it must be fully cooked and never taken away, and finish with a mushroom-over-rice bowl they call unbeatable.
videos.summary_zh: 菌子季，主播专门找还在卖见手青的云南菌子馆，听老板讲为什么必须炒熟、严禁打包，最后用几种野生菌拌饭，直呼“神仙都不换”。

videos.title_zh: 贵州火锅 | 遍布贵州的10元火锅：“把锅底掀了，赶紧拌饭啊！”【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Popular 10 RMB hotpot in Guizhou. How it taste?
videos.summary_en: Guiyang's ubiquitous ¥10 fermented-bean (douchi) hot pot: an ¥8 base, ¥1 side dishes and ¥1 unlimited rice. Everything simmers into one savory, funky stew that exists to be stirred into rice. Plus a street of shops that look out for each other.
videos.summary_zh: 贵阳到处都是的10元豆豉火锅：锅底8元、配菜1元、米饭1元随便吃；所有东西煮成一个味，就是为拌饭而生。

videos.title_zh: 第一次体验云南烧烤，遇到了令人“无法拒绝”的老板娘…
videos.title_en: The first time I experienced Yunnan BBQ, I met the owner of the restaurant who was "unstoppable"...
videos.summary_en: On their first night in Yunnan, Zhu Feifei and Coco are waved into an empty barbecue stall by its gentle owner from Qujing. They learn that a Yunnan barbecue table comes with three dipping dishes, potatoes are compulsory, and the hairy fermented tofu is as pungent as the owner warned.
videos.summary_zh: coffee 组合到云南第一晚，被曲靖来的温柔老板娘请进一家没什么客人的烧烤摊：三种蘸碟、必烤的土豆、长毛的臭豆腐，最后边吃边听路边的祝酒歌。

videos.title_zh: 第一次吃“中国最臭的火锅”，结果出乎意料？这些年我们都误解它了！【盗月社】
videos.title_en: First time to eat"China's smelliest hot pot", the result was unexpected? We've all misunderstood it!
videos.summary_en: A Dong-minority local in Kaili (Qiandongnan) introduces two infamous dishes: pan-fried fermented white tofu, and niubie hot pot, a beef hot pot whose broth includes partly digested grass from the cow's stomach. It turns out far less scary than its reputation.
videos.summary_zh: 凯里（黔东南）本地侗族姑娘带主播挑战两样“狠”东西：小煎锅慢煎的白色臭豆腐，以及用牛胃里半消化青草熬汤的牛瘪火锅；结果比传说中好接受得多。

videos.title_zh: 一口就喷火！看似暗黑却又欲罢不能，吃了才知道，这东西为什么火爆云南街头！| 云南特色美食体验【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Only after you eat it,then you will know why this thing is so popular on the streets of Yunnan!
videos.summary_en: A Mangshi middle-school Chinese teacher (and fan) introduces sapie, the Dai cold dip-and-wrap dish outsiders fear: start with lime sapie, move to the volcanic 'swish chili', then graduate to bitter sapie made with bile broth and raw beef. Plus banana-leaf parcels and grilled fish.
videos.summary_zh: 芒市一位初中语文老师（也是社员）带主播吃让外地人闻风丧胆的傣味撒撇：从柠檬撒入门，进阶涮涮辣，最后挑战用苦肠水和生牛肉做的苦撒；另有包烧和烤鱼。

videos.title_zh: 折耳根 | 体验贵州街头5元小吃，一口飙泪！被当地小学生嘲笑了...【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Experience the extremely cheap Chinese street food. It made me cry! Laughed at by local kids.....
videos.summary_en: In Guiyang the hosts take on zhe'ergen (fish-mint root), Guizhou's most divisive herb: first in 'love tofu', a ¥5 street snack stuffed with it, then at a lunchtime barbecue where locals heap it into their dip, finished with pickled-greens crispy-pork fried rice.
videos.summary_zh: 在贵阳挑战贵州最有争议的折耳根：先吃塞满折耳根的5元恋爱豆腐果，再去午饭烧烤摊学本地人往蘸水里狂加折耳根，最后配盐菜脆哨炒饭。

videos.title_zh: 10元一份，无限加料！文旅局长带我吃才知道，这碗粉为什么会火爆云南～【盗月社】
videos.title_en: 10 yuan a piece! He took me to eat to know why this bowl of noodles is so popular in Yunnan~
videos.summary_en: In Mangshi, Dehong's deputy tourism chief (who they met singing at the Water-Splashing Festival) shows the hosts a breakfast erkuai-noodle shop with what he calls China's longest free condiment bar: 20-plus sauces, fresh limes, mint, coriander and a mysterious wood shaving.
videos.summary_zh: 在芒市，泼水节上偶遇的德宏州文旅局副局长带主播吃早餐饵丝：号称全国调料最多的早点铺，20多种免费调料、新鲜柠檬、薄荷，还有一种刮木屑放的神秘香料。

videos.title_zh: 骗大学生来云南边境，以为免费旅游，谁知半条命没了...【盗月社】
videos.title_en: In order to have a taste of this, I took the college students to the Yunnan border!
videos.summary_en: The hosts take four college students into the rainforest near Mengla to help two elderly beekeepers harvest a year's worth of wild-hive honey, then share a home-cooked village meal after five hours of trekking. Less a food review than a look at where Yunnan's forest honey comes from.
videos.summary_zh: 带四个大学生进勐腊雨林，帮两位养蜂大爹收一年才收一次的蜂蜜，徒步五小时后回村吃一顿家常饭。主要讲雨林蜂蜜从哪来，美食点评不多。

videos.title_zh: 在云南逛集市有多爽？从不知道烤鸡还有这种做法，太香了！【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Visiting a local market in Yunnan | I never knew roast chicken could be cooked like this
videos.summary_en: Dressed as a two-headed mushroom on a rainy day, Zhu Feifei and Coco wander a Yunnan country market: wood-fired corn that pops like popcorn, thumb-sized fried potatoes, fermented tofu, fruit stacked in tidy baskets, and Chuxiong-style beef and chicken smoked over pine needles.
videos.summary_zh: 下雨天扮成蘑菇的 coffee 组合逛云南集市：柴火烤到爆开的苞谷、拇指大的炸小洋芋、发酵小豆腐、码得整整齐齐的水果，还有楚雄特色的松毛烤牛肉和烤鸡。

videos.title_zh: Yunnan再也不敢去云南当美食特种兵了！边陲小城5元一大碗的加辣米线，辣椒嘎嘎炫，好吃飞了～～【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Don’t underestimate Yunnan’s food! A big bowl of spicy rice noodles for 5 yuan is so delicious!
videos.summary_en: A full day of eating in Baoshan, a little-known city in western Yunnan: pea-jelly rice noodles at the morning market, sauce-brushed rice cakes, chili-dusted sour fruit, a famous chili-rice canteen with fried drumsticks, roadside coffee from a farmer on the Nujiang river, and a copper-pot braised beef hot pot for dinner.
videos.summary_zh: 在“最没存在感”的滇西小城保山吃一整天：菜市场的稀豆粉米线、酱粑粑、辣椒拌酸水果、排队的辣子饭和大鸡腿、怒江边咖啡农的路边咖啡，晚上吃铜锅牛肉。

videos.title_zh: 这螃蟹...是来报恩的吧！！| 想吃顿缅甸活螃蟹，还没进门就被带走了……| 云南特色美食体验【盗月社】
videos.title_en: I wanted to eat Burmese live crabs, but I was taken away by the police before I entered the door...
videos.summary_en: Last night of a three-day Dehong series: two local police officers (former border troops) lead the hosts down back alleys in Mangshi to eat live Myanmar mud crabs, steamed and stir-fried with spicy Dai seasonings, then talk about life guarding the border.
videos.summary_zh: 德宏三连拍的最后一晚：两位当地警察（原边防武警）带主播穿小巷子去芒市吃缅甸活青蟹，清蒸和香辣两吃，饭桌上聊起守边的生活。

videos.title_zh: 藏在云南深山里的烧烤王国，一大早挤满上百人...【盗月社 | 云南元阳】
videos.title_en: The Barbecue Kingdom Hidden in the Deep Mountains of Yunnan, Packed with Hundreds at the Crack of...
videos.summary_en: At a mountain market in Yuanyang (Honghe), a whole hall of charcoal basins fires up at 8 a.m. You buy fresh pork or beef from the butchers next door, pay a ¥10-per-person fee to have it marinated, and grill it yourself, with fermented tofu refilled for free.
videos.summary_zh: 红河元阳的山里集市，早上8点就是一整片炭盆烧烤。先在旁边肉铺买新鲜猪肉牛肉，交10元加工费让摊主腌好，自己烤，小豆腐无限续。

videos.title_zh: 贵阳早餐 | 中国南方街头，碳水浓度爆表的早餐！10元超大款，北方人直接爽翻！【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Southern China street food, breakfast with full carbohydrate ! ONLY costs 10 yuan for the big size!
videos.summary_en: A carb-heavy Guiyang breakfast run: a ¥10 'loaded' sticky-rice ball with crispy pork bits, a tidy wet market, and changwang noodles (crisp egg noodles under blood tofu, intestine and crispy pork in red oil) at a shop full of retired veterans debating vinegar.
videos.summary_zh: 贵阳碳水早餐：10元豪华糯米饭（多加脆哨）、整整齐齐的菜市场，以及满是退伍老兵、为放不放醋争论的肠旺面馆。

videos.title_zh: Zunyi贵州街头酸汤方便面，老板：“你下次别来了，我怕”【盗月社 | 鸠占鹊巢】
videos.title_en: Zunyi贵州街头酸汤方便面，老板：“你下次别来了，我怕”【盗月社 | 鸠占鹊巢】
videos.summary_en: Zhu Feifei and Coco wander Zunyi's back alleys on a rainy day: a ¥5 bowl of sour-spicy noodles that a solo vendor keeps topping up, an elderly diner searching for long-lost relatives, and finally a red sour-soup hot pot whose owner adds lemon for fruitiness. The last third is an ad for the channel's own sour-soup noodles.
videos.summary_zh: coffee 组合雨天逛遵义小巷：老板一个人看摊、加了又加的5块钱酸辣粉，偶遇寻找失散亲人的奶奶，最后吃一锅加了柠檬的红酸汤火锅。后三分之一是频道自家酸汤粉的广告。

videos.title_zh: 外地人来云南，一口下去，差点回不来了...【盗月社 | 超级特派员】
videos.title_en: Arriving in Yunnan, one bite almost made me unable to return...
videos.summary_en: A Kunming trip steered by comments from local viewers: the afternoon rush at Mushuihua, the world's biggest wild-mushroom market; a wild-mushroom chicken hot pot in a nearby county; Donghua farmers' market with a 70-year-old volunteer guide, insects and market coffee; a 30-year-old clay-pot rice-noodle shop; and Dian opera make-up at a tiny museum.
videos.summary_zh: 跟着上千条云南网友留言逛昆明：木水花野生菌交易市场下午抢菌子、县里的野生菌鸡汤火锅、有70多岁志愿者讲解的东华农贸市场（虫子、菜市场咖啡）、开了30年的砂锅米线，还有滇戏博物馆体验装扮。

videos.title_zh: 当外地人第一次在云南深山吃到了彩色菌子时……这反应，不敢想象。【盗月社】
videos.title_en: I picked 2 baskets of mushrooms in Yunnan. One basket was poisonous. The other, too...【Daoyue】
videos.summary_en: In Mouding county, Chuxiong, a local mushroom expert (and longtime viewer) takes the hosts foraging in the mountains: red russulas, milk caps you can eat raw, poisonous amanitas and finally a matsutake. Then they cook a mushroom feast at a hilltop campsite: termite-mushroom soup, ganba fried rice and jianshouqing.
videos.summary_zh: 在楚雄牟定，本地菌子专家（也是老社员）带主播上山采菌：红菇、能生吃的奶浆菌、有毒的鹅膏，最后找到一朵松茸；然后在山顶露营地做菌子宴：鸡枞汤、干巴菌火腿炒饭、见手青。

videos.title_zh: 中国最硬的集市！隐藏在云南边境，这玩意儿咋吃啊？【盗月社】
videos.title_en: The most hardcore market in China! Hidden on the border of Yunnan, how do you eat this?
videos.summary_en: With four college students in tow, the hosts visit a Saturday village market (赶摆) in a Dai village near Mengla, Xishuangbanna: barbecue at 8 a.m., pineapple rice, bamboo-tube sticky rice, rice-noodle sheets with free mint. In the evening they eat a stir-fried fermented-bean hot pot at the night market.
videos.summary_zh: 带四个大学生去西双版纳勐腊傣族村寨的周六赶摆：早上8点的烧烤、菠萝饭、竹筒饭、薄荷随便加的卷粉；晚上在夜市吃现炒的豆豉火锅。

videos.title_zh: Yunnan在云南边境小城吃一顿地道的老挝火锅！！猪油润锅，秘酱蘸满，这一口下去......【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Laotian hot pot made with lard and secret sauce in a small town on the Yunnan border!! [Daoyue]
videos.summary_en: On their last night in a Mengla village (on Dai New Year, when many shops close), the hosts find a Laotian hot pot: a domed pan where meat grills on top, fat drips down, and broth for vegetables simmers in the ring below. Lao chili paste, green lime and Lao beer complete it.
videos.summary_zh: 在勐腊村子的最后一晚（傣历新年，很多店关门），吃到一顿老挝火锅：中间凸起烤肉、肥油往下流，四周一圈汤涮菜；配老挝酱、青柠檬和老挝啤酒。

videos.title_zh: 辣椒致死量！千万别在中国贵州吃辣椒，一天3顿怕你上瘾…【盗月社】
videos.title_en: Lethal amount of chilli! Don't eat chili in Guizhou, China, for fear that you will become addicted..
videos.summary_en: A day of Guizhou chili in every form: fire-roasted green chilies peeled and dressed with tomato, a chili-oil rice-noodle bowl with crispy chicken, and a mahjong-hall restaurant's zao lajiao (fermented chili) beef and green-chili chicken that is 85% chili.
videos.summary_zh: 一整天吃遍贵州辣椒的各种做法：火烧青椒撕皮拌番茄、红油辣椒拌粉配脆哨鸡、麻将馆旁小店的糟辣椒牛肉，以及画面85%都是辣椒的青椒鸡。

videos.summary_en: The hosts' last day in Zunyi: mutton rice noodles where the point is the chili, a ¥6 specialty coffee next to the wet market, sticky rice, a riverside run, a hillside market full of chilies, a dozen woks of Zunyi spicy chicken going at once, and charcoal-grilled chicken parts at a former factory district.
videos.summary_zh: 在遵义的最后一天：重点在辣椒的羊肉粉、菜市场旁6块钱的精品咖啡、糯米饭、湘江边跑步、坡上的辣椒市场、十几口锅同时翻炒的遵义辣子鸡，还有老厂区的炭烤鸡。
